ما الذي تغيّر في المشروع، ولماذا؟

هذا الدليل يربط كل تعديل بسببه وبالكود الذي نُفّذ. يغطي إصلاح اتصال المخزون، وفهارس MySQL، وRedis، ولوحة التحكم، وETag، والإشعارات، وتحديثات الواجهة، وأدوات القياس والاختبارات.

المشروع: internet-applications · توثيق العمل بتاريخ 7 نوفمبر 2026 · المصدر: ملفات المشروع الحالية ونتائج docs/performance

المخزون حي دائمًاعقود JSON محفوظةجميع القرارات محسومة57 ملف كود وإعداد موضح

لا توجد شروح مطابقة. جرّب اسم ملف أو كلمة أخرى.

كيف تقرأ هذا الدليل؟

كل بطاقة تعرض الملف، والتغيير، وسببه، ثم الكود. في الملفات المعدّلة تظهر مقارنة Git: الأسطر التي تبدأ بعلامة + أُضيفت، و− حُذفت. وفي الملفات الجديدة يظهر مقتطف معلّم بوضوح. يمكنك فتح النسخة الكاملة لأي ملف ونسخها.

المقارنة مع نقطة Git الأصلية قبل تحسينات Requirement 3. الملف frontend/src/routeTree.gen.ts كان معدّلًا قبل هذه المهمة، لذلك لا ننسب تغييره إلى هذا العمل. ملف التعليمات قدّمتَه أنت، ولم نُعِد كتابته. هذا الدليل شرح للكود الحالي وليس أمرًا لإعادة تطبيق جميع خطوات التعديل.

1 · بياناتبذر بيانات القياس وتسجيل خط الأساس
2 · قاعدة البياناتإضافة الفهارس ثم إعادة القياس
3 · الخادمداشبورد وRedis وبيانات وصفية وETag
4 · صحة العرضمفاتيح إعادة المحاولة وتحديث الاستعلامات
01

بيئة التشغيل وDocker

أصبح التشغيل داخل Ubuntu على WSL باستخدام Docker Engine الأصلي. أُزيل Docker Desktop وبياناته القديمة في مرحلة الإعداد السابقة حسب طلبك. الكود أدناه يوضح إعداد المشروع الحالي؛ لا يعيد تنفيذ حذف أو نقل بيانات.

إضافة Redis وربط الخدمات به

ملف معدّل

docker-compose.yml

أضفنا خدمة Redis داخل شبكة Docker دون نشر منفذها على Windows. حد الذاكرة مضبوط على 512mb وسياسة الإخلاء allkeys-lru. أضفنا CACHE_STORE وREDIS_CLIENT وREDIS_HOST وREDIS_PORT لكل من backend وscheduler، مع انتظار سلامة Redis قبل تشغيلهما.

السبب: يجب أن يرى خادم API والمجدول التخزين المؤقت نفسه؛ وإلا قد يمسح المجدول نسخة مختلفة وتظل أرقام لوحة التحكم قديمة. لم نضف حاوية للواجهة الأمامية، ولا قاعدة بيانات مكررة للقراءة.

الفرق الفعلي مقارنة بنقطة Git الأصلية، ثم النسخة الحالية الكاملة.

المقارنة: + إضافة، − حذف

services:
  # ─── MySQL Database (Laravel) ─────────────────────────────
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: ecommerce-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/mysql_root_password
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ecommerce
      MYSQL_USER: laravel
      MYSQL_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/mysql_password
    ports:
      - "3307:3306"
    volumes:
      - mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    secrets:
      - mysql_root_password
      - mysql_password

  # ─── MySQL Database (Inventory Service) ───────────────────
  inventory-mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: ecommerce-inventory-mysql
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_root_password
      MYSQL_DATABASE: inventory_db
      MYSQL_USER: inventory_service
      MYSQL_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_password
    ports:
      - "3308:3306"
    volumes:
      - inventory_mysql_data:/var/lib/mysql
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    secrets:
      - inventory_mysql_root_password
      - inventory_mysql_password

  # ─── Laravel Backend ──────────────────────────────────────
  backend:
    build:
      context: ./backend/my-project
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: ecommerce-backend
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CACHE_STORE: redis
      REDIS_CLIENT: phpredis
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: 6379
      APP_NAME: "E-Commerce API"
      APP_ENV: local
      APP_DEBUG: "true"
      APP_URL: http://localhost:8000
      APP_KEY: ${APP_KEY}
      DB_CONNECTION: mysql
      DB_HOST: mysql
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_DATABASE: ecommerce
      DB_USERNAME: laravel
      DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/mysql_password
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET}
      INVENTORY_GRPC_HOST: inventory-service:50051
      INVENTORY_GRPC_TIMEOUT: 5
      CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: "http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:3000"
    ports:
      - "8000:8000"
    volumes:
      - backend_storage:/var/www/html/storage/app/public
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    secrets:
      - mysql_password
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:8000/up"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  # ─── Durable compensation scheduler ────────────────────────
  scheduler:
    build:
      context: ./backend/my-project
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: ecommerce-scheduler
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      CACHE_STORE: redis
      REDIS_CLIENT: phpredis
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: 6379
      APP_NAME: "E-Commerce API"
      APP_ENV: local
      APP_DEBUG: "true"
      APP_URL: http://localhost:8000
      APP_KEY: ${APP_KEY}
      DB_CONNECTION: mysql
      DB_HOST: mysql
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_DATABASE: ecommerce
      DB_USERNAME: laravel
      DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/mysql_password
      JWT_SECRET: ${JWT_SECRET}
      INVENTORY_GRPC_HOST: inventory-service:50051
      INVENTORY_GRPC_TIMEOUT: 5
      CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: "http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:3000"
      SKIP_MIGRATIONS: "true"
    command: ["php", "artisan", "schedule:work"]
    volumes:
      - backend_storage:/var/www/html/storage/app/public
    depends_on:
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
      inventory-service:
        condition: service_started
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    secrets:
      - mysql_password

  # ─── Inventory gRPC Service ───────────────────────────────
  inventory-service:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: inventory-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: ecommerce-inventory
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      DB_HOST: inventory-mysql
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_NAME: inventory_db
      DB_USER: inventory_service
      DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_password
      GRPC_PORT: 50051
      NODE_ENV: production
    depends_on:
      inventory-mysql:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    secrets:
      - inventory_mysql_password
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('net').connect(50051,'127.0.0.1').on('connect',()=>process.exit(0)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  # ─── Isolated MySQL/gRPC integration test environment ─────
  mysql-integration:
    profiles: ["mysql-integration"]
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: ecommerce-laravel-test-mysql
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/mysql_integration_root_password
      MYSQL_DATABASE: ecommerce_test
      MYSQL_USER: laravel_test
      MYSQL_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/mysql_integration_password
    ports:
      - "3310:3306"
    volumes:
      - mysql_integration_data:/var/lib/mysql
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    secrets:
      - mysql_integration_root_password
      - mysql_integration_password

  inventory-mysql-integration:
    profiles: ["mysql-integration"]
    image: mysql:8.0
    container_name: ecommerce-inventory-test-mysql
    environment:
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_integration_root_password
      MYSQL_DATABASE: inventory_test
      MYSQL_USER: inventory_test_user
      MYSQL_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_integration_password
    ports:
      - "3311:3306"
    volumes:
      - inventory_mysql_integration_data:/var/lib/mysql
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "mysqladmin", "ping", "-h", "localhost"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
    secrets:
      - inventory_mysql_integration_root_password
      - inventory_mysql_integration_password

  inventory-service-integration:
    profiles: ["mysql-integration"]
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: inventory-service/Dockerfile
    container_name: ecommerce-inventory-test
    environment:
      DB_HOST: inventory-mysql-integration
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_NAME: inventory_test
      DB_USER: inventory_test_user
      DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_integration_password
      GRPC_PORT: 50051
      NODE_ENV: test
    depends_on:
      inventory-mysql-integration:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    secrets:
      - inventory_mysql_integration_password
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "-e", "require('net').connect(50051,'127.0.0.1').on('connect',()=>process.exit(0)).on('error',()=>process.exit(1))"]
      interval: 15s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3

  inventory-test-runner:
    profiles: ["mysql-integration"]
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: inventory-service/Dockerfile
      target: builder
    container_name: ecommerce-inventory-test-runner
    environment:
      RUN_INVENTORY_DB_TESTS: "true"
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_HOST: inventory-mysql-integration
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_PORT: 3306
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_NAME: inventory_test
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_USER: inventory_test_user
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_integration_password
    command: ["npm", "test"]
    depends_on:
      inventory-mysql-integration:
        condition: service_healthy
      inventory-service-integration:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    secrets:
      - inventory_mysql_integration_password

  backend-test:
    profiles: ["mysql-integration"]
    build:
      context: ./backend/my-project
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        INSTALL_DEV_DEPENDENCIES: "true"
    container_name: ecommerce-backend-test
    environment:
      APP_NAME: "E-Commerce API Integration Tests"
      APP_ENV: testing
      APP_DEBUG: "false"
      APP_URL: http://localhost
      APP_KEY: "base64:AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA="
      DB_CONNECTION: mysql
      DB_HOST: mysql-integration
      DB_PORT: 3306
      DB_DATABASE: ecommerce_test
      DB_USERNAME: laravel_test
      DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/mysql_integration_password
      JWT_SECRET: mysql-integration-test-only-secret
      INVENTORY_GRPC_HOST: inventory-service-integration:50051
      INVENTORY_GRPC_TIMEOUT: 5
      RUN_MYSQL_INTEGRATION_TESTS: "true"
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_HOST: inventory-mysql-integration
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_PORT: 3306
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_NAME: inventory_test
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_USER: inventory_test_user
      INVENTORY_TEST_DB_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/inventory_mysql_integration_password
    command: ["php", "vendor/bin/phpunit", "--configuration", "phpunit.mysql.xml"]
    depends_on:
      mysql-integration:
        condition: service_healthy
      inventory-service-integration:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    secrets:
      - mysql_integration_password
      - inventory_mysql_integration_password

  # ─── Frontend (React + Vite) ──────────────────────────────
  frontend:
    build:
      context: ./frontend
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    container_name: ecommerce-frontend
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "5173:80"
    depends_on:
      backend:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network

  # Shared application cache; intentionally not published to the host.
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: ecommerce-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: ["redis-server", "--maxmemory", "512mb", "--maxmemory-policy", "allkeys-lru"]
    networks:
      - ecommerce-network
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "redis-cli", "ping"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5

# ─── Networks ───────────────────────────────────────────────
networks:
  ecommerce-network:
    driver: bridge

# ─── Volumes ────────────────────────────────────────────────
volumes:
  mysql_data:
  inventory_mysql_data:
  mysql_integration_data:
  inventory_mysql_integration_data:
  backend_storage:

# ─── Secrets ────────────────────────────────────────────────
secrets:
  mysql_root_password:
    file: ./secrets/mysql_root_password.txt
  mysql_password:
    file: ./secrets/mysql_password.txt
  inventory_mysql_root_password:
    file: ./secrets/inventory_mysql_root_password.txt
  inventory_mysql_password:
    file: ./secrets/inventory_mysql_password.txt
  mysql_integration_root_password:
    file: ./secrets/mysql_integration_root_password.txt
  mysql_integration_password:
    file: ./secrets/mysql_integration_password.txt
  inventory_mysql_integration_root_password:
    file: ./secrets/inventory_mysql_integration_root_password.txt
  inventory_mysql_integration_password:
    file: ./secrets/inventory_mysql_integration_password.txt

تثبيت امتداد Redis في PHP

ملف معدّل

backend/my-project/Dockerfile

أضفنا تثبيت redis عبر PECL وتفعيله في صورة PHP. وجود خادم Redis وحده غير كافٍ؛ PHP يحتاج عميلًا يتصل به، واخترنا phpredis.

أبقينا أمر تشغيل خادم التطوير كما هو وفق قرارك. لم نضف nginx أو PHP-FPM ولم نغيّر إعدادات OPcache ضمن هذه المهمة.

الفرق الفعلي مقارنة بنقطة Git الأصلية، ثم النسخة الحالية الكاملة.

المقارنة: + إضافة، − حذف
diff --git a/backend/my-project/Dockerfile b/backend/my-project/Dockerfile
index ce48de9..da5f126 100644
--- a/backend/my-project/Dockerfile
+++ b/backend/my-project/Dockerfile
@@ -20,8 +20,12 @@ COPY --from=composer:latest /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer
 # Install grpc and protobuf PHP extensions
 RUN pecl install grpc protobuf \
     && docker-php-ext-enable grpc protobuf
 
+# Shared application cache. Stock is always fetched live.
+RUN pecl install redis \
+    && docker-php-ext-enable redis
+
 # Set working directory
 WORKDIR /var/www/html
 
 # Copy composer files first for better caching
عرض الكود الكامل · 67 سطرًا
الكود الفعلي · للقراءة والنسخ
FROM php:8.2-cli

# Install system dependencies
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    curl \
    libpng-dev \
    libonig-dev \
    libxml2-dev \
    zip \
    unzip \
    default-mysql-client \
    && docker-php-ext-install pdo_mysql mbstring exif pcntl bcmath gd \
    && apt-get clean \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install Composer
COPY --from=composer:latest /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer

# Install grpc and protobuf PHP extensions
RUN pecl install grpc protobuf \
    && docker-php-ext-enable grpc protobuf

# Shared application cache. Stock is always fetched live.
RUN pecl install redis \
    && docker-php-ext-enable redis

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /var/www/html

# Copy composer files first for better caching
COPY composer.json composer.lock ./

# Install dependencies
ARG INSTALL_DEV_DEPENDENCIES=false
RUN if [ "$INSTALL_DEV_DEPENDENCIES" = "true" ]; then \
        composer install --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts; \
    else \
        composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-scripts; \
    fi

# Copy application code
COPY . .

# Run post-install scripts
RUN composer run-script post-autoload-dump

# Create storage directories
RUN mkdir -p storage/framework/cache/data \
    storage/framework/sessions \
    storage/framework/views \
    storage/logs \
    storage/app/public/products \
    bootstrap/cache

# Set permissions
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/html \
    && chmod -R 775 storage bootstrap/cache

# Create entrypoint script
COPY docker-entrypoint.sh /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-entrypoint.sh

EXPOSE 8000

ENTRYPOINT ["docker-entrypoint.sh"]
CMD ["php", "artisan", "serve", "--host=0.0.0.0", "--port=8000"]

تحديث مثال إعداد التخزين المؤقت

ملف معدّل

backend/my-project/.env.example

غيّرنا القيمة الافتراضية في ملف المثال من database إلى redis، ليكون إعداد النسخ الجديدة متوافقًا مع التغيير.

هذا ملف مثال فقط، وليس ملف الأسرار الحقيقي. داخل Docker تحدد متغيرات compose عنوان Redis باسم الخدمة redis.

الفرق الفعلي مقارنة بنقطة Git الأصلية، ثم النسخة الحالية الكاملة.

المقارنة: + إضافة، − حذف

-CACHE_STORE=database

02

إصلاح اتصال PHP بخدمة المخزون

هذه إصلاحات لازمة قبل قياس الأداء: اختبارات المخزون كشفت أن امتداد PHP موجود، لكن مكتبة SDK مفقودة، ثم ظهر عدم توافق في فك الرسائل. أُعيد خط الأساس بعد الإصلاح؛ لم نغيّر شيفرة خدمة inventory-service.

إضافة مكتبة grpc/grpc

ملف معدّل

backend/my-project/composer.json

أضفنا اعتماد grpc/grpc لأن InventoryGrpcStub يعتمد على Grpc\BaseStub. امتداد grpc ومكتبة Composer جزءان مختلفان؛ تثبيت الامتداد لا يوفر صنف BaseStub.

تم تثبيت الإصدار 1.85.0 في القفل، مع إبقاء إصدارات بقية الحزم المقفلة كما كانت. هذا إصلاح تشغيل وليس نتيجة لتحسين الكاش.

الفرق الفعلي مقارنة بنقطة Git الأصلية، ثم النسخة الحالية الكاملة.

المقارنة: + إضافة، − حذف
diff --git a/backend/my-project/composer.json b/backend/my-project/composer.json
index 053186f..d249f17 100644
--- a/backend/my-project/composer.json
+++ b/backend/my-project/composer.json
@@ -6,8 +6,9 @@
     "keywords": ["laravel", "framework"],
     "license": "MIT",
     "require": {
         "php": "^8.2",
+        "grpc/grpc": "^1.85",
         "laravel/framework": "^12.0",
         "laravel/tinker": "^2.10.1",
         "php-open-source-saver/jwt-auth": "2.8"
     },

تثبيت إصدار الاعتماد الجديد

ملف معدّل

backend/my-project/composer.lock

سجّلنا الحزمة الجديدة في ملف القفل حتى يستخدم البناء اللاحق الإصدار نفسه بدل اختيار إصدار مختلف تلقائيًا.

الفرق أدناه يعرض بيانات الاعتماد التي أضيفت فعلًا. لم نحدّث بقية الاعتمادات لمعالجة التنبيهات الأمنية التي أبلغ عنها Composer؛ تلك خارج نطاق المهمة.

محوّل يحقق عقد فك رسائل SDK

ملف جديد

backend/my-project/app/Services/InventoryProtoResponse.php

أضفنا صنفًا أساسيًا ينفذ mergeFromString ثم يحفظ نتيجة فك الرسالة كمصفوفة. هذه الدالة هي ما يتوقعه SDK عند استقبال البيانات الثنائية.

تسمح toArray بإعادة النتيجة إلى الشكل الذي يستخدمه كود المشروع، دون تغيير استجابات API العامة.

الكود الكامل للملف الجديد.

الكود الفعلي · للقراءة والنسخ
<?php

namespace App\Services;

/** Adapter for grpc/grpc's generated-message deserialization contract. */
abstract class InventoryProtoResponse
{
    private array $data = [];

    final public function mergeFromString(string $bytes): void
    {
        $this->data = $this->decode($bytes);
    }

    final public function toArray(): array
    {
        return $this->data;
    }

    abstract protected function decode(string $bytes): array;
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Grpc\BaseStub;
use Grpc\ChannelCredentials;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class InventoryGrpcClient
{
    private ?object $client = null;

    private string $host;

    private int $timeoutMicros;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->host = (string) config('services.inventory.grpc_host', 'inventory-service:50051');
        $this->timeoutMicros = (int) config('services.inventory.grpc_timeout', 5) * 1_000_000;
    }

    public function isGrpcAvailable(): bool
    {
        return extension_loaded('grpc') && class_exists(BaseStub::class);
    }

    public function shouldFallback(): bool
    {
        return ! $this->isGrpcAvailable() && app()->environment('local');
    }

    public function getStock(int $productId): int
    {
        if ($this->shouldFallback()) {
            return $this->fallbackGetStock($productId);
        }

        $response = $this->call('GetStock', ['product_id' => $productId]);

        if (! ($response['found'] ?? false)) {
            return 0;
        }

        return (int) $response['available_quantity'];
    }

    /**
     * @param  array<array{product_id:int, quantity:int}>  $items
     */
    public function reserveStock(array $items, string $idempotencyKey): ReservationResult
    {
        if ($this->shouldFallback()) {
            return $this->fallbackReserveStock($items, $idempotencyKey);
        }

        $aggregated = [];
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $productId = (int) $item['product_id'];
            $aggregated[$productId] = ($aggregated[$productId] ?? 0) + (int) $item['quantity'];
        }
        ksort($aggregated, SORT_NUMERIC);

        $requestItems = [];
        foreach ($aggregated as $productId => $quantity) {
            $requestItems[] = ['product_id' => (int) $productId, 'quantity' => $quantity];
        }

        $response = $this->call('ReserveStock', [
            'items' => $requestItems,
            'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
        ]);

        $success = (bool) ($response['success'] ?? false);
        $reservationId = ($response['reservation_id'] ?? '') !== '' ? $response['reservation_id'] : null;
        if ($success && $reservationId === null) {
            throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('Inventory service confirmed a reservation without an ID.');
        }

        return new ReservationResult(
            success: $success,
            reservationId: $reservationId,
            reason: ($response['failure_reason'] ?? '') !== '' ? $response['failure_reason'] : null,
        );
    }

    public function releaseStock(string $reservationId): bool
    {
        if ($this->shouldFallback()) {
            return $this->fallbackReleaseStock($reservationId);
        }

        $response = $this->call('ReleaseStock', ['reservation_id' => $reservationId]);

        return (bool) ($response['success'] ?? false);
    }

    private function fallbackGetStock(int $productId): int
    {
        try {
            $item = DB::connection('inventory')->table('inventory_items')
                ->where('product_id', $productId)
                ->first();

            if (! $item) {
                return 0;
            }

            return max(0, (int) $item->total_quantity - (int) $item->reserved_quantity);
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            throw new InventoryUnavailableException('Inventory service is unavailable.');
        }
    }

    private function fallbackReserveStock(array $items, string $idempotencyKey): ReservationResult
    {
        try {
            return DB::connection('inventory')->transaction(function () use ($items, $idempotencyKey) {
                $existing = DB::connection('inventory')->table('reservations')
                    ->where('idempotency_key', $idempotencyKey)
                    ->first();

                if ($existing) {
                    if ($existing->status === 'confirmed') {
                        return new ReservationResult(true, $existing->reservation_id, null);
                    }

                    return new ReservationResult(false, null, 'RESERVATION_' . strtoupper($existing->status));
                }

                $aggregated = [];
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $pid = (int) $item['product_id'];
                    $aggregated[$pid] = ($aggregated[$pid] ?? 0) + (int) $item['quantity'];
                }
                ksort($aggregated, SORT_NUMERIC);

                foreach ($aggregated as $productId => $quantity) {
                    $inv = DB::connection('inventory')->table('inventory_items')
                        ->where('product_id', $productId)
                        ->lockForUpdate()
                        ->first();

                    if (! $inv) {
                        return new ReservationResult(false, null, 'PRODUCT_NOT_FOUND');
                    }

                    $available = (int) $inv->total_quantity - (int) $inv->reserved_quantity;
                    if ($available < $quantity) {
                        return new ReservationResult(false, null, 'INSUFFICIENT_STOCK');
                    }
                }

                $reservationId = (string) Str::uuid();
                $requestHash = hash('sha256', json_encode(['items' => $items, 'key' => $idempotencyKey]));

                DB::connection('inventory')->table('reservations')->insert([
                    'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                    'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
                    'status' => 'confirmed',
                    'request_hash' => $requestHash,
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ]);

                foreach ($aggregated as $productId => $quantity) {
                    DB::connection('inventory')->table('inventory_items')
                        ->where('product_id', $productId)
                        ->increment('reserved_quantity', $quantity);

                    DB::connection('inventory')->table('reservation_items')->insert([
                        'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                        'product_id' => $productId,
                        'quantity' => $quantity,
                        'created_at' => now(),
                    ]);
                }

                return new ReservationResult(true, $reservationId, null);
            });
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            throw new InventoryUnavailableException('Inventory request failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    private function fallbackReleaseStock(string $reservationId): bool
    {
        try {
            return DB::connection('inventory')->transaction(function () use ($reservationId) {
                $reservation = DB::connection('inventory')->table('reservations')
                    ->where('reservation_id', $reservationId)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first();

                if (! $reservation) {
                    return true;
                }

                if ($reservation->status === 'released') {
                    return true;
                }

                $items = DB::connection('inventory')->table('reservation_items')
                    ->where('reservation_id', $reservationId)
                    ->get();

                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    DB::connection('inventory')->table('inventory_items')
                        ->where('product_id', $item->product_id)
                        ->decrement('reserved_quantity', $item->quantity);
                }

                DB::connection('inventory')->table('reservations')
                    ->where('reservation_id', $reservationId)
                    ->update([
                        'status' => 'released',
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);

                return true;
            });
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            throw new InventoryUnavailableException('Inventory request failed: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

    private function call(string $method, array $request): array
    {
        $client = $this->client();
        $call = $client->{$method}($request, [], ['timeout' => $this->timeoutMicros]);
        [$response, $status] = $call->wait();

        if ($status->code !== \Grpc\STATUS_OK) {
            if ($status->code === \Grpc\STATUS_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED && $method === 'ReserveStock') {
                throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('Inventory request deadline exceeded.');
            }

            if ($status->code === \Grpc\STATUS_UNAVAILABLE || $status->code === \Grpc\STATUS_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED) {
                throw new InventoryUnavailableException('Inventory service is unavailable.');
            }

            throw new InventoryUnavailableException('Inventory request failed.');
        }

        if ($response instanceof InventoryProtoResponse) {
            $response = $response->toArray();
        }

        if (! is_array($response)) {
            throw new InventoryUnavailableException('Inventory service returned an invalid response.');
        }

        return $response;
    }

    private function client(): object
    {
        if ($this->client !== null) {
            return $this->client;
        }

        if (! extension_loaded('grpc') || ! class_exists(BaseStub::class)) {
            throw new InventoryUnavailableException('The PHP gRPC extension is not installed.');
        }

        require_once __DIR__.'/InventoryGrpcStub.php';
        $this->client = new InventoryGrpcStub($this->host, [
            'credentials' => ChannelCredentials::createInsecure(),
        ]);

        return $this->client;
    }
}
03

البيانات الكبيرة وفهارس قاعدة البيانات

أنشأنا بيانات قياس قبل إضافة الفهارس، ثم نفّذنا EXPLAIN وEXPLAIN ANALYZE قبل التعديل وبعده. لم نعدّل أي migration قديم ولم نعد تهيئة قاعدة التطبيق الرئيسية.

إنشاء بيانات واقعية نسبيًا للقياس

ملف جديد

backend/my-project/database/seeders/BulkOrderSeeder.php

أضفنا Seeder الوارد في الملحق C لتوليد 300,000 طلب تجريبي مع المستخدمين وعناصر الطلبات. وجود بيانات قليلة جدًا كان سيخفي تكلفة الاستعلامات.

النتيجة الفعلية: 5,004 مستخدمين، و15 منتجًا، و300,004 طلبات، و749,372 عنصر طلب. الزمن المقاس 109.983502 ثانية. البيانات السابقة الأربعة للطلبات بقيت موجودة. لا تشغّل البذر مرة أخرى على القاعدة الحالية.

مقتطف من الملف الجديد؛ الكود الكامل متاح أدناه.

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Generates a large dataset for performance testing (Requirement 3).
 *
 * Run AFTER UserSeeder and ProductSeeder:
 *   BULK_ORDER_COUNT=300000 php artisan db:seed --class=Database\\Seeders\\BulkOrderSeeder
 *
 * Inserts are chunked and use the query builder (no Eloquent events, no model hydration)
 * so that hundreds of thousands of rows can be created in a reasonable time.
 * The seeder refuses to run twice; run `php artisan migrate:fresh --seed` to regenerate.
 */
class BulkOrderSeeder extends Seeder
{
    private const DEFAULT_ORDER_COUNT = 300000;
    private const BULK_CUSTOMERS = 5000;
    private const ORDERS_PER_CHUNK = 1000;
    private const ITEM_INSERT_BATCH = 1000;
    private const HISTORY_SECONDS = 365 * 24 * 3600;

    // Weights are percentages and must add up to 100.
    private const STATUS_WEIGHTS = [
        'pending' => 5,
        'confirmed' => 10,
        'processing' => 10,
        'shipped' => 15,
        'delivered' => 55,
        'cancelled' => 5,
    ];

    public function run(): void
    {
        DB::disableQueryLog();

        if (DB::table('users')->where('email', 'like', 'bulk-customer-%')->exists()) {
            $this->command?->warn('Bulk data already exists. Run migrate:fresh --seed to regenerate.');

            return;
        }

        $products = DB::table('products')
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->whereNull('deleted_at')
            ->get(['id', 'price'])
            ->all();

        if (count($products) === 0) {
            $this->command?->error('No active products found. Run ProductSeeder first.');

            return;
        }

        $targetOrders = (int) (getenv('BULK_ORDER_COUNT') ?: self::DEFAULT_ORDER_COUNT);
        $customerIds = $this->createCustomers();

        $remaining = $targetOrders;
        $generated = 0;

        while ($remaining > 0) {
            $size = min(self::ORDERS_PER_CHUNK, $remaining);
            $this->insertOrderChunk($size, $customerIds, $products);

            $remaining -= $size;
            $generated += $size;

            if ($generated % 50000 === 0 || $remaining === 0) {
                $this->command?->info("Generated {$generated} / {$targetOrders} orders");
            }
        }

        $this->command?->info('Bulk seeding finished.');
    }

    /**
     * @return array<int, int> customer user IDs
     */
    private function createCustomers(): array
    {
        // Hash once and reuse. Bcrypt per user would make seeding very slow.
        $password = Hash::make('password123');
        $now = now()->format('Y-m-d H:i:s');

        $rows = [];
        for ($i = 1; $i <= self::BULK_CUSTOMERS; $i++) {
            $rows[] = [
                'name' => "Bulk Customer {$i}",
                'email' => "bulk-customer-{$i}@example.test",
                'password' => $password,
                'role' => 'customer',
                'created_at' => $now,
                'updated_at' => $now,
            ];
        }

        foreach (array_chunk($rows, 1000) as $chunk) {
            DB::table('users')->insert($chunk);
        }

        return DB::table('users')
            ->where('email', 'like', 'bulk-customer-%')
            ->pluck('id')
            ->map(fn ($id) => (int) $id)
            ->all();
    }

    private function insertOrderChunk(int $size, array $customerIds, array $products): void
    {
        DB::transaction(function () use ($size, $customerIds, $products) {
            $orderRows = [];
            $itemsByReservation = [];

            for ($i = 0; $i < $size; $i++) {
                $reservationId = (string) Str::uuid();
                $createdAt = now()->subSeconds(random_int(0, self::HISTORY_SECONDS))->format('Y-m-d H:i:s');

                $total = '0.00';
                $items = [];
                $itemCount = random_int(1, 4);

                for ($j = 0; $j < $itemCount; $j++) {
                    $product = $products[array_rand($products)];
                    $quantity = random_int(1, 3);
                    $subtotal = bcmul((string) $product->price, (string) $quantity, 2);
                    $total = bcadd($total, $subtotal, 2);

                    $items[] = [
                        'product_id' => $product->id,
                        'quantity' => $quantity,
                        'unit_price' => $product->price,
                        'subtotal' => $subtotal,
                        'created_at' => $createdAt,
                        'updated_at' => $createdAt,
                    ];
                }

                $orderRows[] = [
                    'user_id' => $customerIds[array_rand($customerIds)],
                    'total' => $total,
                    'status' => $this->pickStatus(),
                    'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                    'created_at' => $createdAt,
                    'updated_at' => $createdAt,
                ];
                $itemsByReservation[$reservationId] = $items;
            }

            // Remember the highest ID before this chunk. The new orders are exactly the rows above it.
            // This avoids relying on auto-increment values being consecutive for multi-row inserts.
            $maxIdBefore = (int) DB::table('orders')->max('id');

            DB::table('orders')->insert($orderRows);

            $orderIdByReservation = DB::table('orders')
                ->where('id', '>', $maxIdBefore)
                ->pluck('id', 'reservation_id');

            $itemRows = [];
            foreach ($itemsByReservation as $reservationId => $items) {
                $orderId = $orderIdByReservation[$reservationId];
                foreach ($items as $item) {
                    $item['order_id'] = $orderId;
                    $itemRows[] = $item;
                }
            }

            foreach (array_chunk($itemRows, self::ITEM_INSERT_BATCH) as $batch) {
                DB::table('order_items')->insert($batch);
            }
        });
    }

    private function pickStatus(): string
    {
        $roll = random_int(1, 100);
        $cumulative = 0;

        foreach (self::STATUS_WEIGHTS as $status => $weight) {
            $cumulative += $weight;
            if ($roll <= $cumulative) {
                return $status;
            }
        }

        return 'pending';
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\DashboardCache;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;

class DashboardController extends Controller
{
    /**
     * Dashboard numbers may be up to this many seconds old.
     * Services that change orders should call DashboardCache::forgetCache() so the
     * affected user sees fresh numbers immediately.
     */
    private const CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 60;

    public function __invoke(): JsonResponse
    {
        $user = Auth::guard('api')->user();
        $isAdmin = $user->role === 'admin';

        $data = Cache::remember(
            DashboardCache::cacheKey($user->id, $isAdmin),
            self::CACHE_TTL_SECONDS,
            fn () => $this->buildStats($user->id, $isAdmin)
        );

        return response()->json(['data' => $data]);
    }

    private function buildStats(int $userId, bool $isAdmin): array
    {
        // One pass over the orders table instead of three separate queries.
        // created_at is compared as a range, not with whereDate(), so an index can still be used.
        $orders = DB::table('orders');
        if (! $isAdmin) {
            $orders->where('user_id', $userId);
        }

        $orderStats = $orders->selectRaw(
            'COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
             COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS orders_today,
             COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status <> ? THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sales',
            [now()->startOfDay(), 'cancelled']
        )->first();

        return [
            'total_products' => Product::query()->where('is_active', true)->count(),
            'orders_today' => (int) $orderStats->orders_today,
            'total_orders' => (int) $orderStats->total_orders,
            'total_users' => $isAdmin ? User::query()->count() : null,
            // bcmath keeps money as a decimal string, consistent with OrderService.
            'total_sales' => bcadd((string) $orderStats->total_sales, '0', 2),
        ];
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class DashboardCache
{
    public static function cacheKey(int $userId, bool $isAdmin): string
    {
        return $isAdmin ? 'dashboard:admin' : "dashboard:user:{$userId}";
    }

    public static function forgetCache(int $userId): void
    {
        Cache::forget(self::cacheKey($userId, false));
        self::forgetAdmin();
    }

    public static function forgetAdmin(): void
    {
        Cache::forget('dashboard:admin');
    }
}

أضفنا get وput وforget. put يحمّل التصنيف، ويحذف stock من البيانات حتى لو كان قد أضيف للكائن، ثم يحفظ اللقطة لمدة 300 ثانية.

رغم أن اللقطة تتضمن حقول المنتج الوصفية، التنفيذ النهائي يعيد استخدام علاقة التصنيف فقط. لا نقدم السعر من لقطة قديمة ولا نتجاوز فحص كون المنتج نشطًا.

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class ProductCache
{
    public function get(int $id): ?array
    {
        $value = Cache::get("product:{$id}:details");

        return is_array($value) ? $value : null;
    }

    public function put(Product $product): void
    {
        $product->loadMissing('category');
        $attributes = $product->toArray();
        // Stock must never enter this cache, even if a caller already loaded it.
        unset($attributes['stock']);
        Cache::put("product:{$product->id}:details", $attributes, 300);
    }

    public function forget(int $id): void
    {
        Cache::forget("product:{$id}:details");
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreProductRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateProductRequest;
use App\Http\Resources\ProductResource;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Services\InventoryGrpcClient;
use App\Services\InventoryUnavailableException;
use App\Services\ProductService;
use App\Services\ProductCache;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;

class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly InventoryGrpcClient $inventoryClient,
        private readonly ProductService $products,
        private readonly ProductCache $productCache
    ) {}

    public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $query = Product::with('category')->where('is_active', true);

        if ($request->filled('category_id')) {
            $query->where('category_id', $request->integer('category_id'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('search')) {
            $query->where('name', 'like', '%'.$request->string('search')->toString().'%');
        }

        $perPage = min(max($request->integer('per_page', 15), 1), 100);

        return ProductResource::collection($query->orderByDesc('created_at')->orderByDesc('id')->paginate($perPage));
    }

    public function show(Product $product): JsonResponse|ProductResource
    {
        if (! $product->is_active && request()->user()?->role !== 'admin') {
            abort(404);
        }

        // Route binding remains authoritative for price, visibility and other product fields.
        // Only the category relation is reused from the non-stock cache snapshot.
        $cached = $this->productCache->get($product->id);
        if ($cached === null) {
            $product->load('category');
            $this->productCache->put($product);
        } else {
            $category = $cached['category'] ?? null;
            $product->setRelation('category', $category === null ? null :
                $product->category()->getRelated()->newFromBuilder($category, $product->getConnectionName()));
        }

        try {
            $stock = $this->inventoryClient->getStock($product->id);
        } catch (InventoryUnavailableException $exception) {
            return response()->json([
                'message' => 'Current inventory is unavailable. Please try again.',
                'code' => $exception->getCodeName(),
            ], 503);
        }

        $product->setAttribute('stock', $stock);

        return new ProductResource($product);
    }

    public function store(StoreProductRequest $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $product = $this->products->create($request->validated());

        return (new ProductResource($product->load('category')))->response()->setStatusCode(201);
    }

    public function update(UpdateProductRequest $request, Product $product): ProductResource
    {
        return new ProductResource($this->products->update($product->id, $request->validated()));
    }

    public function destroy(Product $product): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->products->delete($product->id);

        return response()->json(['message' => 'Product deactivated.']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;

class ProductService
{
    public function __construct(private readonly ProductCache $cache) {}

    /**
     * Find a single product by ID.
     */
    public function find(int $id): Product
    {
        return Product::with('category')->findOrFail($id);
    }

    /**
     * Create a new product with optional image upload.
     */
    public function create(array $data): Product
    {
        if (isset($data['image']) && $data['image'] instanceof \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile) {
            $data['image'] = $data['image']->store('products', 'public');
        }

        $product = Product::create($data);
        DashboardCache::forgetAdmin();

        return $product;
    }

    /**
     * Update an existing product.
     */
    public function update(int $id, array $data): Product
    {
        $product = Product::findOrFail($id);

        if (isset($data['image']) && $data['image'] instanceof \Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile) {
            // Delete old image if exists
            if ($product->image) {
                Storage::disk('public')->delete($product->image);
            }
            $data['image'] = $data['image']->store('products', 'public');
        }

        $product->update($data);
        $this->cache->forget($id);
        DashboardCache::forgetAdmin();

        return $product->fresh('category');
    }

    /**
     * Soft delete a product.
     */
    public function delete(int $id): void
    {
        $product = Product::findOrFail($id);
        $product->delete();
        $this->cache->forget($id);
        DashboardCache::forgetAdmin();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class NotificationService
{
    /**
     * Get paginated notifications for a user.
     */
    public function getUserNotifications(User $user): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        return $user->notifications()->orderByDesc('created_at')->orderByDesc('id')->paginate(15);
    }

    /**
     * Mark a specific notification as read.
     */
    public function markAsRead(string $id, User $user): void
    {
        $notification = $user->notifications()->findOrFail($id);
        $notification->markAsRead();
    }

    /**
     * Mark all notifications as read.
     */
    public function markAllAsRead(User $user): void
    {
        $user->unreadNotifications()->update(['read_at' => now()]);
    }

    /**
     * Create an order notification for a user.
     */
    public function createOrderNotification(User $user, Order $order, string $type): void
    {
        $data = [
            'order_id' => $order->id,
            'status' => $order->status,
            'total' => $order->total,
        ];

        $message = match ($type) {
            'order_created' => "Your order #{$order->id} has been placed successfully.",
            'order_status_updated' => "Your order #{$order->id} status changed to {$order->status}.",
            default => "Order #{$order->id} update.",
        };

        $data['message'] = $message;

        // Use database notification directly
        $user->notifications()->create([
            'id' => Str::uuid()->toString(),
            'type' => 'App\\Notifications\\OrderNotification',
            'data' => $data,
        ]);
    }
}

إعادة التحقق باستخدام ETag

ETag يصف محتوى الاستجابة النهائية. عند تكرار الطلب بالمحتوى نفسه يمكن إرسال 304 دون جسم JSON. هذا يقلل البيانات المرسلة، ولا يلغي جلب المخزون الحي أو تنفيذ المسار.

إنشاء ETag بعد تجهيز استجابة JSON

ملف جديد

backend/my-project/app/Http/Middleware/ConditionalGet.php

بعد تنفيذ المسار، نتعامل فقط مع GET الناجح 200 من نوع JSON. نحسب SHA-1 لمحتوى الاستجابة، ونضع Cache-Control: private, no-cache ثم نفحص If-None-Match عبر isNotModified.

private يمنع تخزين الاستجابة في كاش مشترك، وno-cache يطلب إعادة التحقق قبل إعادة استخدامها. إذا تغير المخزون يتغير الجسم وبالتالي ETag. الاستجابة 503 لا تتحول إلى 304. قياساتنا أظهرت تقليلًا في البايتات دون تحسن مثبت في زمن detail.

الكود الكامل للملف الجديد.

الكود الفعلي · للقراءة والنسخ
<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class ConditionalGet
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $response = $next($request);
        if ($request->isMethod('GET') && $response instanceof JsonResponse && $response->getStatusCode() === 200) {
            // Compute after rendering: the representation still includes live stock.
            $response->setEtag('"'.sha1($response->getContent()).'"');
            $response->headers->set('Cache-Control', 'private, no-cache');
            $response->isNotModified($request);
        }

        return $response;
    }
}

<?php

use App\Http\Middleware\EnsureAdmin;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware;

return Application::configure(basePath: dirname(__DIR__))
    ->withRouting(
        web: __DIR__.'/../routes/web.php',
        api: __DIR__.'/../routes/api.php',
        commands: __DIR__.'/../routes/console.php',
        health: '/up',
    )
    ->withMiddleware(function (Middleware $middleware) {
        $middleware->trustProxies(at: '*');

        $middleware->alias([
            'admin' => EnsureAdmin::class,
            'conditional.get' => \App\Http\Middleware\ConditionalGet::class,
            'check.ip.lockout' => \App\Http\Middleware\CheckIpLockout::class,
        ]);
    })
    ->withExceptions(function (Exceptions $exceptions) {
        $exceptions->render(function (\Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException $e, \Illuminate\Http\Request $request) {
            if ($request->is('api/*') || $request->expectsJson()) {
                return response()->json([
                    'message' => $e->getMessage() ?: 'This action is unauthorized.',
                ], 403);
            }
        });
    })->create();

<?php

use App\Http\Controllers\AuthController;
use App\Http\Controllers\CategoryController;
use App\Http\Controllers\DashboardController;
use App\Http\Controllers\NotificationController;
use App\Http\Controllers\OrderController;
use App\Http\Controllers\ProductController;
use App\Http\Controllers\UserController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

Route::middleware('check.ip.lockout')->group(function () {
    Route::post('/login', [AuthController::class, 'login']);
    Route::post('/register', [AuthController::class, 'register'])->middleware('throttle:register');

    Route::middleware('throttle:categories')->group(function () {
        Route::get('/categories', [CategoryController::class, 'index']);
        Route::get('/categories/{category}', [CategoryController::class, 'show']);
    });

    Route::middleware('throttle:products')->group(function () {
        Route::get('/products', [ProductController::class, 'index'])->middleware('conditional.get');
        Route::get('/products/{product}', [ProductController::class, 'show'])->middleware('conditional.get');
    });

    Route::middleware('auth:api')->group(function () {
        Route::middleware('throttle:general')->group(function () {
            Route::post('/logout', [AuthController::class, 'logout']);
            Route::get('/me', [AuthController::class, 'me']);
            Route::get('/dashboard', DashboardController::class);
        });

        Route::middleware('throttle:orders')->group(function () {
            Route::post('/orders', [OrderController::class, 'store']);
            Route::get('/orders', [OrderController::class, 'index']);
            Route::get('/orders/{order}', [OrderController::class, 'show']);
        });

        Route::middleware('throttle:notifications')->group(function () {
            Route::get('/notifications', [NotificationController::class, 'index']);
            Route::patch('/notifications/read-all', [NotificationController::class, 'markAllAsRead']);
            Route::patch('/notifications/{notification}/read', [NotificationController::class, 'markAsRead']);
        });

        Route::middleware('admin')->group(function () {
            Route::middleware('throttle:categories')->group(function () {
                Route::apiResource('categories', CategoryController::class)->except(['index', 'show']);
            });
            Route::middleware('throttle:products')->group(function () {
                Route::apiResource('products', ProductController::class)->except(['index', 'show']);
            });
            Route::middleware('throttle:general')->group(function () {
                Route::get('/users', [UserController::class, 'index']);
            });
            Route::middleware('throttle:orders')->group(function () {
                Route::get('/admin/orders', [OrderController::class, 'adminIndex']);
                Route::patch('/admin/orders/{order}/status', [OrderController::class, 'updateStatus']);
            });
        });
    });
});

الطلبات والإشعارات بعد تثبيت المعاملة

اخترتَ تفويض القرار المعقول في T9. التنفيذ الحالي يحافظ على الطلب بعد نجاح حفظه؛ فشل الإشعار اللاحق يُسجّل ولا يلغي الطلب أو يحرر مخزونه المحجوز خطأً.

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\FailedCompensation;
use App\Models\InventoryOperation;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Pagination\LengthAwarePaginator;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

class OrderService
{
    public function __construct(
        protected InventoryGrpcClient $inventoryClient,
        protected NotificationService $notificationService,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Create a new order.
     *
     * 1. Validate products exist and are active
     * 2. Get prices from DB (not client)
     * 3. Call gRPC ReserveStock
     * 4. If reservation fails, return error with reason
     * 5. If reservation succeeds, save order + items in DB transaction
     * 6. If DB save fails, call gRPC ReleaseStock, log failure, create FailedCompensation if release fails
     * 7. Create notification for user
     * 8. Return order
     */
    public function createOrder(User $user, array $items, string $idempotencyKey): Order
    {
        $normalizedItems = collect($items)
            ->map(fn (array $item) => [
                'product_id' => (int) $item['product_id'],
                'quantity' => (int) $item['quantity'],
            ])
            ->sortBy(['product_id', 'quantity'])
            ->values()
            ->all();
        $requestHash = hash('sha256', json_encode($normalizedItems, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));

        DB::table('inventory_operations')->insertOrIgnore([
            'idempotency_key' => $idempotencyKey,
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'request_hash' => $requestHash,
            'status' => 'pending',
            'created_at' => now(),
            'updated_at' => now(),
        ]);
        $operation = InventoryOperation::where('idempotency_key', $idempotencyKey)->firstOrFail();

        if ($operation->user_id !== $user->id || ! hash_equals($operation->request_hash, $requestHash)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different order.');
        }
        if ($operation->status === 'completed') {
            return Order::with('items.product')->findOrFail($operation->order_id);
        }
        if ($operation->status === 'compensation_pending') {
            throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('A prior compensation is still pending.');
        }
        if ($operation->status === 'compensated') {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The previous attempt was compensated. Use a new Idempotency-Key.');
        }

        $productIds = array_column($items, 'product_id');
        $products = Product::whereIn('id', $productIds)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->get()
            ->keyBy('id');

        // Check all products exist and are active
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            if (! $products->has($item['product_id'])) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException(
                    "Product ID {$item['product_id']} not found or is inactive."
                );
            }
        }

        $orderItems = [];
        $total = '0.00';
        foreach ($items as $item) {
            $product = $products[$item['product_id']];
            $unitPrice = $product->price;
            $subtotal = bcmul($unitPrice, (string) $item['quantity'], 2);
            $total = bcadd($total, $subtotal, 2);

            $orderItems[] = [
                'product_id' => $product->id,
                'quantity' => $item['quantity'],
                'unit_price' => $unitPrice,
                'subtotal' => $subtotal,
            ];
        }

        $reservationId = null;
        try {
            $reservedOperation = DB::transaction(function () use (
                $operation,
                $items,
                $idempotencyKey
            ) {
                $lockedOperation = InventoryOperation::query()
                    ->whereKey($operation->id)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->firstOrFail();

                if ($lockedOperation->status === 'completed') {
                    return $lockedOperation;
                }
                if ($lockedOperation->status === 'compensation_pending') {
                    throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('A prior compensation is still pending.');
                }
                if ($lockedOperation->status === 'compensated') {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException('The previous attempt was compensated. Use a new Idempotency-Key.');
                }

                if ($lockedOperation->status === 'pending') {
                    $reservation = $this->inventoryClient->reserveStock($items, $idempotencyKey);
                    if (! $reservation->success) {
                        throw new InsufficientStockException(
                            $reservation->reason ?: 'Insufficient stock for one or more products.'
                        );
                    }
                    if (! $reservation->reservationId) {
                        throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('Reservation was not confirmed with an ID.');
                    }

                    $lockedOperation->update([
                        'status' => 'reserved',
                        'reservation_id' => $reservation->reservationId,
                    ]);
                }

                if ($lockedOperation->status !== 'reserved' || ! $lockedOperation->reservation_id) {
                    throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('Reservation operation is not in a recoverable state.');
                }

                return $lockedOperation->fresh();
            });
            $reservationId = $reservedOperation->reservation_id;

            if ($reservedOperation->status === 'completed') {
                return Order::with('items.product')->findOrFail($reservedOperation->order_id);
            }

            $order = DB::transaction(function () use ($operation, $user, $total, $orderItems) {
                $lockedOperation = InventoryOperation::query()
                    ->whereKey($operation->id)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->firstOrFail();

                if ($lockedOperation->status === 'completed') {
                    return Order::with('items.product')->findOrFail($lockedOperation->order_id);
                }
                if ($lockedOperation->status !== 'reserved' || ! $lockedOperation->reservation_id) {
                    throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('Confirmed reservation state is unavailable.');
                }

                $order = Order::create([
                    'user_id' => $user->id,
                    'total' => $total,
                    'status' => 'pending',
                    'reservation_id' => $lockedOperation->reservation_id,
                ]);

                foreach ($orderItems as $item) {
                    $order->items()->create($item);
                }

                $lockedOperation->update([
                    'status' => 'completed',
                    'order_id' => $order->id,
                    'last_error' => null,
                ]);
                $this->notifyAfterCommit($user, $order, 'order_created');

                return $order;
            });
        } catch (InsufficientStockException|InventoryUnavailableException $exception) {
            throw $exception;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            if ($reservationId === null) {
                try {
                    $durableOperation = InventoryOperation::find($operation->id);
                    if ($durableOperation?->status === 'completed') {
                        return Order::with('items.product')->findOrFail($durableOperation->order_id);
                    }
                    $reservationId = $durableOperation?->reservation_id;
                } catch (\Throwable $lookupException) {
                    Log::critical('Could not determine whether an order reservation was persisted', [
                        'operation_id' => $operation->id,
                        'error' => $lookupException->getMessage(),
                    ]);
                    throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('Order persistence outcome is not known.');
                }
            }

            if ($reservationId === null) {
                throw $e;
            }

            try {
                $durableOperation = InventoryOperation::find($operation->id);
                if ($durableOperation?->status === 'completed') {
                    return Order::with('items.product')->findOrFail($durableOperation->order_id);
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $lookupException) {
                Log::critical('Could not verify order persistence before compensation', [
                    'operation_id' => $operation->id,
                    'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                    'error' => $lookupException->getMessage(),
                ]);
                throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('Order persistence outcome is not known.');
            }

            Log::error('Order creation failed, attempting stock release', [
                'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                'error' => $e->getMessage(),
            ]);

            $released = false;
            $compensationError = null;
            try {
                $released = $this->inventoryClient->releaseStock($reservationId);
                if (! $released) {
                    $compensationError = 'Inventory service did not confirm the release.';
                }
            } catch (\Throwable $releaseException) {
                $compensationError = $releaseException->getMessage();
            }

            DB::transaction(function () use ($operation, $reservationId, $released, $compensationError, $e) {
                $lockedOperation = InventoryOperation::query()
                    ->whereKey($operation->id)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->firstOrFail();
                $lockedOperation->update([
                    'status' => $released ? 'compensated' : 'compensation_pending',
                    'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                    'last_error' => $released ? $e->getMessage() : $compensationError,
                ]);

                if (! $released) {
                    FailedCompensation::firstOrCreate(
                        ['operation_id' => $lockedOperation->id],
                        [
                            'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                            'status' => 'pending',
                            'error_message' => $compensationError,
                            'attempts' => 1,
                            'last_attempted_at' => now(),
                        ]
                    );
                }
            });

            if (! $released) {
                Log::critical('Stock compensation recorded for retry', [
                    'operation_id' => $operation->id,
                    'reservation_id' => $reservationId,
                    'error' => $compensationError,
                ]);
            }

            throw $e;
        }

        DashboardCache::forgetCache($user->id);

        return $order->load('items.product');
    }

    /**
     * Get paginated orders for a user.
     */
    public function getUserOrders(User $user, ?string $status = null): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $query = $user->orders()->with('items.product')->orderByDesc('created_at')->orderByDesc('id');

        if ($status !== null) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        return $query->paginate(15);
    }

    /**
     * Get a single order with items.
     */
    public function getOrder(int $id): Order
    {
        return Order::with('items.product')->findOrFail($id);
    }

    /**
     * Get all orders (admin).
     */
    public function getAllOrders(?string $status = null): LengthAwarePaginator
    {
        $query = Order::with('items.product', 'user')->orderByDesc('created_at')->orderByDesc('id');

        if ($status !== null) {
            $query->where('status', $status);
        }

        return $query->paginate(15);
    }

    /**
     * Update order status with valid state transitions.
     */
    public function updateStatus(Order $order, string $status): Order
    {
        $validTransitions = [
            'pending' => ['confirmed', 'cancelled'],
            'confirmed' => ['processing', 'cancelled'],
            'processing' => ['shipped', 'cancelled'],
            'shipped' => ['delivered'],
            'delivered' => [],
            'cancelled' => [],
        ];

        $currentStatus = $order->status;

        if (! isset($validTransitions[$currentStatus]) ||
            ! in_array($status, $validTransitions[$currentStatus])) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException(
                "Cannot transition from '{$currentStatus}' to '{$status}'."
            );
        }

        if ($status === 'cancelled' && $order->reservation_id !== null) {
            if (! $this->inventoryClient->releaseStock($order->reservation_id)) {
                throw new InventoryUnavailableException('Stock release could not be confirmed.');
            }
        }

        $order->update(['status' => $status]);
        DashboardCache::forgetCache($order->user_id);

        // Notify user of status change
        $this->notifyAfterCommit(
            $order->user,
            $order,
            'order_status_updated'
        );

        return $order->fresh('items.product');
    }

    private function notifyAfterCommit(User $user, Order $order, string $type): void
    {
        DB::afterCommit(function () use ($user, $order, $type): void {
            try {
                $this->notificationService->createOrderNotification($user, $order, $type);
            } catch (\Throwable $exception) {
                // The order is committed. A secondary notification must not undo it.
                Log::error('Order notification failed after commit', [
                    'order_id' => $order->id,
                    'user_id' => $user->id,
                    'type' => $type,
                    'error' => $exception->getMessage(),
                ]);
            }
        });
    }

}

تعديلات الواجهة الأمامية التي وافقت عليها A–D

هذه تغييرات في الواجهة لتحسين صحة إعادة المحاولة وحداثة العرض. React Query يحتفظ بالبيانات دقيقتين افتراضيًا؛ لذلك نطلب تحديث الاستعلامات المتأثرة مباشرة بعد نجاح الكتابة.

import { apiClient } from "@/lib/api/client"
import { endpoints } from "@/lib/api/endpoints"
import type { OrderStatus } from "@/lib/constants/order-status"
import type { ApiResponse, PaginatedResponse } from "@/types/api"
import type { Order, OrderItemInput, OrderWithUser } from "../types"

export const ordersApi = {
  getMine: async (page = 1, status?: OrderStatus) => {
    const { data } = await apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<Order>>(endpoints.orders.list, {
      params: { page, status },
    })
    return data
  },

  getById: async (id: number) => {
    const { data } = await apiClient.get<ApiResponse<Order>>(endpoints.orders.detail(id))
    return data.data
  },

  /**
   * الـ Idempotency-Key مطلوب من الباك (UUID v4).
   * مرّر نفس المفتاح عند إعادة المحاولة لنفس الطلب، عشان ما يتكرر الطلب.
   */
  create: async (items: OrderItemInput[], idempotencyKey: string) => {
    const { data } = await apiClient.post<ApiResponse<Order>>(
      endpoints.orders.create,
      { items },
      { headers: { "Idempotency-Key": idempotencyKey } }
    )
    return data.data
  },

  // ─── Admin ───
  adminGetAll: async (page = 1, status?: OrderStatus) => {
    const { data } = await apiClient.get<PaginatedResponse<OrderWithUser>>(
      endpoints.orders.admin.list,
      { params: { page, status } }
    )
    return data
  },

  adminUpdateStatus: async (id: number, status: OrderStatus) => {
    const { data } = await apiClient.patch<ApiResponse<Order>>(
      endpoints.orders.admin.updateStatus(id),
      { status }
    )
    return data.data
  },
}

import { keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query"
import { useCreate, useGet, useGetAll, useUpdate } from "@/hooks/api"
import type { OrderStatus } from "@/lib/constants/order-status"
import { ordersApi } from "../api/orders.api"
import type { OrderItemInput } from "../types"
import { dashboardKeys } from "@/features/dashboard/hooks/use-dashboard"
import { productKeys } from "@/features/products/hooks/use-products"

export const orderKeys = {
  all: ["orders"] as const,
  lists: () => [...orderKeys.all, "list"] as const,
  list: (page: number, status?: OrderStatus) =>
    [...orderKeys.lists(), page, status] as const,
  details: () => [...orderKeys.all, "detail"] as const,
  detail: (id: number) => [...orderKeys.details(), id] as const,
}

export function useOrders(page: number, status?: OrderStatus, isAdmin = false) {
  return useGetAll(
    orderKeys.list(page, status),
    () => isAdmin ? ordersApi.adminGetAll(page, status) : ordersApi.getMine(page, status),
    { placeholderData: keepPreviousData }
  )
}

export function useOrder(id: number) {
  return useGet(orderKeys.detail(id), () => ordersApi.getById(id), {
    enabled: Number.isInteger(id) && id > 0,
  })
}

export function useUpdateOrderStatus(id: number) {
  return useUpdate(
    (status: OrderStatus) => ordersApi.adminUpdateStatus(id, status),
    {
      invalidateKeys: [orderKeys.lists(), orderKeys.detail(id), dashboardKeys.summary, productKeys.details()],
      successMessage: "تم تحديث حالة الطلب",
      errorMessage: "تعذر تحديث حالة الطلب",
    }
  )
}

export function useCreateOrder() {
  return useCreate(
    (input: { items: OrderItemInput[]; idempotencyKey: string }) =>
      ordersApi.create(input.items, input.idempotencyKey),
    {
      invalidateKeys: [orderKeys.lists(), dashboardKeys.summary, productKeys.details()],
      successMessage: "تم إنشاء طلبك بنجاح",
      errorMessage: "تعذر إنشاء الطلب",
    }
  )
}

import { keepPreviousData } from "@tanstack/react-query"
import { useGet, useGetAll, useCreate, useUpdate, useDelete } from "@/hooks/api"
import { productsApi } from "../api/products.api"
import type { ProductFilters, ProductInput, ProductUpdateInput } from "../types"
import { dashboardKeys } from "@/features/dashboard/hooks/use-dashboard"

/**
 * Query Keys – مصدر واحد لكل مفاتيح المنتجات
 */
export const productKeys = {
  all: ["products"] as const,
  lists: () => [...productKeys.all, "list"] as const,
  list: (filters: ProductFilters) => [...productKeys.lists(), filters] as const,
  details: () => [...productKeys.all, "detail"] as const,
  detail: (id: number) => [...productKeys.details(), id] as const,
}

/** جلب قائمة المنتجات */
export function useProducts(filters: ProductFilters = {}) {
  return useGetAll(
    productKeys.list(filters),
    () => productsApi.getAll(filters),
    // نحتفظ بالصفحة السابقة أثناء تحميل الجديدة بدل ما يختفي الجدول
    { placeholderData: keepPreviousData }
  )
}

/** جلب منتج واحد مع المخزون */
export function useProduct(id: number) {
  return useGet(productKeys.detail(id), () => productsApi.getById(id), {
    enabled: !!id,
  })
}

/** إضافة منتج */
export function useCreateProduct() {
  return useCreate((input: ProductInput) => productsApi.create(input), {
    invalidateKeys: [productKeys.lists(), dashboardKeys.summary],
    successMessage: "تم إضافة المنتج بنجاح",
    errorMessage: "فشل إضافة المنتج",
  })
}

/** تحديث منتج */
export function useUpdateProduct(id: number) {
  return useUpdate((input: ProductUpdateInput) => productsApi.update(id, input), {
    invalidateKeys: [productKeys.lists(), productKeys.detail(id)],
    successMessage: "تم تحديث المنتج بنجاح",
    errorMessage: "فشل تحديث المنتج",
  })
}

/** تعطيل منتج (الباك ما يحذفه نهائياً) */
export function useDeleteProduct() {
  return useDelete((id: number) => productsApi.delete(id), {
    invalidateKeys: [productKeys.lists(), productKeys.details(), dashboardKeys.summary],
    successMessage: "تم تعطيل المنتج",
    errorMessage: "فشل تعطيل المنتج",
  })
}

الاحتفاظ بالمفتاح لنفس محاولة الطلب

ملف معدّل

frontend/src/features/products/components/product-details.tsx

أضفنا useRef لحفظ fingerprint للعناصر مع UUID. إذا أعاد المستخدم المحاولة بالعناصر نفسها يُستخدم المفتاح نفسه. عند اختلاف المنتج أو الكمية تتغير البصمة/يُصفّر المرجع، وبعد النجاح يُصفّر المفتاح المطابق.

المفتاح موجود في ذاكرة هذا المكوّن فقط؛ لا ندّعي حفظه بعد إعادة تحميل الصفحة أو إزالة المكوّن. لم نغيّر النص العربي أو نجعل الواجهة تنشئ حجز المخزون بنفسها.

import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useProduct } from "../hooks/use-products";
import { useCreateOrder } from "@/features/orders/hooks/use-orders";
import { useAuthStore } from "@/features/auth/stores/auth.store";
import { LoadingSpinner } from "@/components/feedback/loading-spinner";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/feedback/empty-state";
import { formatCurrency, formatDate } from "@/lib/utils/format";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Pencil, ArrowRight, ShoppingCart } from "lucide-react";
import { ROLES } from "@/lib/constants/roles";

interface ProductDetailsProps {
  productId: number;
}

export function ProductDetails({ productId }: ProductDetailsProps) {
  const { data: product, isLoading, error } = useProduct(productId);
  const isAdmin = useAuthStore((state) => state.user?.role === ROLES.ADMIN);
  const createOrder = useCreateOrder();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(1);
  const orderAttempt = useRef<{ fingerprint: string; key: string } | null>(null);

  const isForbidden = error?.statusCode === 403;
  const isStockDown = error?.statusCode === 503;

  if (isLoading) return <LoadingSpinner text="جاري تحميل المنتج..." />;

  if (error || !product) {
    return (
      <EmptyState
        title={
          isForbidden
            ? "لا تملك صلاحية الوصول"
            : isStockDown
              ? "خدمة المخزون غير متاحة"
              : "المنتج غير موجود"
        }
        description={error?.message ?? "لم نتمكن من العثور على هذا المنتج."}
        action={
          <Button asChild variant="outline">
            <Link to="/products">العودة للمنتجات</Link>
          </Button>
        }
      />
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" asChild>
          <Link to="/products">
            <ArrowRight className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
            العودة
          </Link>
        </Button>
        {isAdmin && (
          <Button asChild>
            <Link
              to="/products/$productId/edit"
              params={{ productId: String(product.id) }}
            >
              <Pencil className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
              تعديل
            </Link>
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3">
        <Card className="lg:col-span-1">
          <CardContent className="flex aspect-square items-center justify-center p-6">
            {product.image_url ? (
              <img
                src={product.image_url}
                alt={product.name}
                className="max-h-full rounded-lg object-contain"
              />
            ) : (
              <div className="flex h-full w-full items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                لا توجد صورة
              </div>
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="lg:col-span-2">
          <CardHeader>
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <CardTitle className="text-2xl">{product.name}</CardTitle>
                <div className="mt-2 flex gap-2">
                  <Badge variant="secondary">{product.category.name}</Badge>
                  <Badge variant={product.is_active ? "default" : "outline"}>
                    {product.is_active ? "نشط" : "معطّل"}
                  </Badge>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-left">
                <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-primary">
                  {formatCurrency(product.price)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="space-y-4">
            {product.description && (
              <div>
                <h3 className="mb-1 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground">
                  الوصف
                </h3>
                <p className="leading-relaxed">{product.description}</p>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 border-t pt-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">المخزون المتوفر</p>
                <p className="text-lg font-semibold">{product.stock}</p>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">تاريخ الإضافة</p>
                <p className="text-lg font-semibold">
                  {formatDate(product.created_at)}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <form
              className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3 border-t pt-4"
              onSubmit={(event) => {
                event.preventDefault();
                const items = [{ product_id: product.id, quantity }];
                const fingerprint = JSON.stringify(items);
                // Keep one key when retrying exactly the same item list.
                if (orderAttempt.current?.fingerprint !== fingerprint) {
                  orderAttempt.current = { fingerprint, key: crypto.randomUUID() };
                }
                const attempt = orderAttempt.current;
                createOrder.mutate({ items, idempotencyKey: attempt.key }, {
                  onSuccess: () => {
                    if (orderAttempt.current === attempt) orderAttempt.current = null;
                    navigate({ to: "/orders" });
                  },
                });
              }}
            >
              <div className="w-28">
                <label
                  htmlFor="order-quantity"
                  className="mb-2 block text-sm font-medium"
                >
                  الكمية
                </label>
                <Input
                  id="order-quantity"
                  type="number"
                  min={1}
                  max={product.stock}
                  value={quantity}
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const nextQuantity = Math.max(1, Number(event.target.value));
                    if (nextQuantity !== quantity) orderAttempt.current = null;
                    setQuantity(nextQuantity);
                  }}
                  disabled={product.stock < 1}
                />
              </div>
              <Button
                type="submit"
                disabled={createOrder.isPending || product.stock < 1}
              >
                <ShoppingCart className="ml-2 h-4 w-4" />
                {product.stock < 1 ? "غير متوفر" : "اطلب الآن"}
              </Button>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
