الكود الفعلي · للقراءة والنسخ
<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Services\InventoryProtoCodec;
use App\Services\InventoryProtoMessage;
use App\Services\InventoryStockResponse;
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

class InventoryProtoCodecTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_stock_message_supports_the_grpc_library_deserializer(): void
    {
        $call = (new \ReflectionClass(\Grpc\UnaryCall::class))->newInstanceWithoutConstructor();
        $property = new \ReflectionProperty(\Grpc\AbstractCall::class, 'deserialize');
        $property->setValue($call, [InventoryStockResponse::class, 'decode']);
        $method = new \ReflectionMethod(\Grpc\AbstractCall::class, '_deserializeResponse');
        $response = $method->invoke($call, chr(8).chr(9).chr(32).chr(7).chr(40).chr(1));

        $this->assertInstanceOf(InventoryStockResponse::class, $response);
        $this->assertSame(7, $response->toArray()['available_quantity']);
        $this->assertTrue($response->toArray()['found']);
    }

    public function test_reserve_request_matches_the_proto_wire_format(): void
    {
        $message = new InventoryProtoMessage([
            'items' => [
                ['product_id' => 300, 'quantity' => 2],
            ],
            'idempotency_key' => 'fixed-key',
        ], [InventoryProtoCodec::class, 'encodeReserveStock']);

        $this->assertSame(
            '0a0508ac021002120966697865642d6b6579',
            bin2hex($message->serializeToString())
        );
    }

    public function test_stock_response_decodes_inventory_service_fields(): void
    {
        $wire = chr(8).chr(9)
            .chr(16).chr(12)
            .chr(24).chr(3)
            .chr(32).chr(9)
            .chr(40).chr(1);

        $this->assertSame([
            'product_id' => 9,
            'total_quantity' => 12,
            'reserved_quantity' => 3,
            'available_quantity' => 9,
            'found' => true,
        ], InventoryProtoCodec::decodeGetStock($wire));
    }

    public function test_reservation_response_decodes_repeated_item_results(): void
    {
        $wire = chr(8).chr(1)
            .chr(18).chr(3).'res'
            .chr(34).chr(8).chr(8).chr(1).chr(16).chr(2).chr(24).chr(5).chr(32).chr(1);

        $this->assertSame([
            'success' => true,
            'reservation_id' => 'res',
            'failure_reason' => '',
            'item_results' => [[
                'product_id' => 1,
                'requested_quantity' => 2,
                'available_quantity' => 5,
                'sufficient' => true,
            ]],
        ], InventoryProtoCodec::decodeReserveStock($wire));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Tests\TestCase;

class PerformanceCachingTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_dashboard_cache_is_scoped_and_preserves_the_json_contract(): void
    {
        $first = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'customer']);
        $second = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'customer']);
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'admin']);
        Order::create(['user_id' => $first->id, 'total' => '10.25', 'status' => 'pending']);
        Order::create(['user_id' => $second->id, 'total' => '20.50', 'status' => 'pending']);
        Order::create(['user_id' => $second->id, 'total' => '4.00', 'status' => 'cancelled']);

        $body = $this->actingAs($first, 'api')->getJson('/api/dashboard')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_orders', 1)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.total_users', null)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.total_sales', '10.25')->json('data');
        $this->assertEqualsCanonicalizing([
            'total_products', 'orders_today', 'total_orders', 'total_users', 'total_sales',
        ], array_keys($body));
        $this->assertTrue(Cache::has('dashboard:user:'.$first->id));

        $this->actingAs($second, 'api')->getJson('/api/dashboard')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_orders', 2)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.total_sales', '20.50');
        $this->actingAs($admin, 'api')->getJson('/api/dashboard')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_orders', 3)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.total_users', 3)
            ->assertJsonPath('data.total_sales', '30.75');
        $this->actingAs($first, 'api')->getJson('/api/dashboard')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_orders', 1);
    }

    public function test_order_pagination_is_complete_when_timestamps_are_equal(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $ids = [];
        $timestamp = now()->startOfSecond();
        for ($i = 0; $i < 43; $i++) {
            $ids[] = Order::create(['user_id' => $user->id, 'total' => '1.00',
                'status' => 'pending', 'created_at' => $timestamp])->id;
        }
        $received = [];
        for ($page = 1; $page <= 3; $page++) {
            $response = $this->actingAs($user, 'api')->getJson('/api/orders?page='.$page)
                ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('meta.total', 43);
            $received = array_merge($received, array_column($response->json('data'), 'id'));
        }
        $this->assertCount(43, array_unique($received));
        $this->assertSame(array_reverse($ids), $received);
    }


    public function test_product_cache_excludes_stock_and_invalidates_after_writes(): void
    {
        $category = \App\Models\Category::create(['name' => 'Cache category']);
        $product = \App\Models\Product::create(['name' => 'Cache product', 'price' => '10.00',
            'category_id' => $category->id, 'is_active' => true]);
        $cache = app(\App\Services\ProductCache::class);
        $product->load('category')->setAttribute('stock', 99);
        $cache->put($product);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('stock', $cache->get($product->id));
        app(\App\Services\ProductService::class)->update($product->id, ['price' => '12.34']);
        $this->assertNull($cache->get($product->id));

        $inventory = \Mockery::mock(\App\Services\InventoryGrpcClient::class);
        $inventory->shouldReceive('getStock')->twice()->with($product->id)->andReturn(6, 4);
        $this->app->instance(\App\Services\InventoryGrpcClient::class, $inventory);
        $this->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.price', '12.34')->assertJsonPath('data.stock', 6);
        $this->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.stock', 4);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('stock', $cache->get($product->id));
        app(\App\Services\ProductService::class)->delete($product->id);
        $this->assertNull($cache->get($product->id));
        $this->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)->assertNotFound();
    }


    public function test_etag_revalidates_live_stock_and_keeps_an_empty_304_body(): void
    {
        $category = \App\Models\Category::create(['name' => 'Conditional category']);
        $product = \App\Models\Product::create(['name' => 'Conditional product', 'price' => '1.00',
            'category_id' => $category->id, 'is_active' => true]);
        $inventory = \Mockery::mock(\App\Services\InventoryGrpcClient::class);
        $inventory->shouldReceive('getStock')->times(3)->andReturn(9, 9, 8);
        $this->app->instance(\App\Services\InventoryGrpcClient::class, $inventory);
        $first = $this->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)->assertOk();
        $etag = $first->headers->get('ETag');
        $this->assertNotEmpty($etag);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('private', $first->headers->get('Cache-Control'));
        $this->assertStringContainsString('no-cache', $first->headers->get('Cache-Control'));
        $this->withHeader('If-None-Match', $etag)->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)
            ->assertStatus(304)->assertContent('');
        $last = $this->withHeader('If-None-Match', $etag)->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.stock', 8);
        $this->assertNotSame($etag, $last->headers->get('ETag'));
    }


    public function test_product_management_refreshes_the_cached_admin_product_count(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'admin']);
        $category = \App\Models\Category::create(['name' => 'Dashboard category']);
        $this->actingAs($admin, 'api')->getJson('/api/dashboard')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_products', 0);
        $product = $this->postJson('/api/products', ['name' => 'Dashboard product', 'price' => '2.00',
            'category_id' => $category->id, 'is_active' => true])->assertCreated()->json('data');
        $this->getJson('/api/dashboard')->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_products', 1);
        $this->deleteJson('/api/products/'.$product['id'])->assertOk();
        $this->getJson('/api/dashboard')->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_products', 0);
    }

}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\FailedCompensation;
use App\Models\InventoryOperation;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\InventoryGrpcClient;
use App\Services\InventoryOutcomeUnknownException;
use App\Services\InventoryUnavailableException;
use App\Services\OrderService;
use App\Services\ReservationResult;
use Carbon\Carbon;
use Illuminate\Http\UploadedFile;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Mockery;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ApiWorkflowTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        config(['jwt.secret' => str_repeat('a', 32)]);
    }

    public function test_registration_login_and_token_protected_identity(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/register', [
            'name' => 'New Customer',
            'email' => 'customer@example.test',
            'password' => 'StrongPass123',
            'password_confirmation' => 'StrongPass123',
            'role' => 'admin',
        ]);

        $response->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('user.role', 'customer')
            ->assertJsonMissingPath('user.password');

        $user = User::where('email', 'customer@example.test')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertNotSame('StrongPass123', $user->password);

        $login = $this->postJson('/api/login', [
            'email' => $user->email,
            'password' => 'StrongPass123',
        ])->assertOk();

        $token = $login->json('access_token');
        $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/me')
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.email', $user->email);

        $this->postJson('/api/login', [
            'email' => $user->email,
            'password' => 'incorrect',
        ])->assertUnauthorized();
    }

    public function test_protected_identity_rejects_missing_and_invalid_tokens(): void
    {
        $this->getJson('/api/me')->assertUnauthorized();
        $this->withToken('not-a-valid-jwt')->getJson('/api/me')->assertUnauthorized();
    }

    public function test_grpc_client_does_not_fake_a_reservation_when_the_extension_is_missing(): void
    {
        if (extension_loaded('grpc')) {
            $this->markTestSkipped('This assertion only applies when the PHP gRPC extension is unavailable.');
        }

        $this->expectException(InventoryUnavailableException::class);
        app(InventoryGrpcClient::class)->reserveStock(
            [['product_id' => 1, 'quantity' => 1]],

    public function test_customers_cannot_manage_products_but_admins_can(): void
    {

            ])->assertForbidden();

    public function test_admin_product_management_supports_create_update_and_deactivation(): void
    {
        $category = Category::create(['name' => 'Product management']);
        $customer = User::factory()->create();
        $product = $this->makeProduct();

        $this->withToken(auth('api')->login($customer))
            ->putJson('/api/products/'.$product->id, ['name' => 'Customer edit'])
            ->assertForbidden();
        $this->withToken(auth('api')->login($customer))
            ->deleteJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)
            ->assertForbidden();

        $admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'admin']);
        $adminToken = auth('api')->login($admin);

        $created = $this->withToken($adminToken)
            ->postJson('/api/products', [
                'name' => 'Created by admin',
                'price' => '15.00',
                'category_id' => $category->id,
            ])
            ->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.name', 'Created by admin');
        $createdId = $created->json('data.id');

        $this->withToken($adminToken)
            ->putJson('/api/products/'.$createdId, ['name' => 'Updated by admin'])
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.name', 'Updated by admin');

        $this->withToken($adminToken)
            ->deleteJson('/api/products/'.$createdId)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('message', 'Product deactivated.');

        $this->assertSoftDeleted('products', ['id' => $createdId]);
        $this->getJson('/api/products?search=Updated')
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonCount(0, 'data');
    }

    public function test_order_reserves_once_uses_server_price_and_is_idempotent(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $product = $this->makeProduct('12.34');
        $inventory = Mockery::mock(InventoryGrpcClient::class);
        $inventory->shouldReceive('reserveStock')
            ->once()
            ->andReturn(new ReservationResult(true, 'reservation-1'));
        $this->app->instance(InventoryGrpcClient::class, $inventory);

        $key = (string) Str::uuid();
        $payload = [
            'items' => [[
                'product_id' => $product->id,
                'quantity' => 2,
                'unit_price' => '0.01',
            ]],
            'total' => '0.02',
        ];
        $token = auth('api')->login($user);

        $this->withToken($token)->withHeader('Idempotency-Key', $key)
            ->postJson('/api/orders', $payload)
            ->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.total', '24.68');

        $this->withToken($token)->withHeader('Idempotency-Key', $key)
            ->postJson('/api/orders', $payload)
            ->assertCreated()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.total', '24.68');

        $this->assertSame(1, Order::count());
    }

    public function test_unknown_reservation_outcome_can_be_retried_with_the_same_idempotency_key(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $product = $this->makeProduct();
        $key = (string) Str::uuid();
        $items = [['product_id' => $product->id, 'quantity' => 1]];

        $inventory = Mockery::mock(InventoryGrpcClient::class);
        $attempt = 0;
        $inventory->shouldReceive('reserveStock')
            ->twice()
            ->with($items, $key)
            ->andReturnUsing(function () use (&$attempt): ReservationResult {
                if (++$attempt === 1) {
                    throw new InventoryOutcomeUnknownException('deadline');
                }

                return new ReservationResult(true, 'reservation-after-timeout');
            });
        $this->app->instance(InventoryGrpcClient::class, $inventory);
        $token = auth('api')->login($user);

        $this->withToken($token)->withHeader('Idempotency-Key', $key)
            ->postJson('/api/orders', ['items' => $items])
            ->assertStatus(503)
            ->assertJsonPath('code', 'RESERVATION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN');
        $this->assertSame(0, Order::count());

        $this->withToken($token)->withHeader('Idempotency-Key', $key)
            ->postJson('/api/orders', ['items' => $items])
            ->assertCreated();
        $this->assertSame(1, Order::count());
    }

    public function test_failed_order_save_releases_stock_and_persists_retryable_compensation(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $product = $this->makeProduct();
        $operationKey = (string) Str::uuid();

        $inventory = Mockery::mock(InventoryGrpcClient::class);
        $inventory->shouldReceive('reserveStock')
            ->once()
            ->andReturn(new ReservationResult(true, 'reservation-failed-save'));
        $inventory->shouldReceive('releaseStock')
            ->once()
            ->with('reservation-failed-save')
            ->andReturn(false);
        $this->app->instance(InventoryGrpcClient::class, $inventory);

        // Exercise an actual order-persistence failure; notifications now run after commit.
        Order::created(static function (): void {
            throw new RuntimeException('Simulated order persistence failure');
        });

        try {
            app(OrderService::class)->createOrder($user, [
                ['product_id' => $product->id, 'quantity' => 1],
            ], $operationKey);
            $this->fail('The simulated persistence failure should be rethrown.');
        } catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
            $this->assertSame('Simulated order persistence failure', $exception->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, Order::count());
        $this->assertSame('compensation_pending', InventoryOperation::where('idempotency_key', $operationKey)->value('status'));
        $this->assertSame('pending', FailedCompensation::where('reservation_id', 'reservation-failed-save')->value('status'));
    }

    public function test_retry_command_recovers_stale_reservations_and_releases_idempotently(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $operation = InventoryOperation::create([
            'idempotency_key' => (string) Str::uuid(),
            'user_id' => $user->id,
            'request_hash' => hash('sha256', 'stale'),
            'status' => 'reserved',
            'reservation_id' => 'reservation-stale',
        ]);
        Carbon::setTestNow(now()->subMinutes(6));
        $operation->touch();
        Carbon::setTestNow();

        $inventory = Mockery::mock(InventoryGrpcClient::class);
        $inventory->shouldReceive('releaseStock')
            ->once()
            ->with('reservation-stale')
            ->andReturn(true);
        $this->app->instance(InventoryGrpcClient::class, $inventory);

        $this->assertSame(0, Artisan::call('inventory:retry-compensations'));
        $this->assertSame('compensated', $operation->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame(
            'completed',
            FailedCompensation::where('operation_id', $operation->id)->value('status')
        );
    }

    public function test_order_policy_access_control_cases(): void
    {
        $customerA = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'customer']);
        $customerB = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'customer']);
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['role' => 'admin']);

        $orderA = Order::create([
            'user_id' => $customerA->id,
            'total' => '50.00',
            'status' => 'pending',
        ]);

        $tokenA = auth('api')->login($customerA);
        // 1. Customer A requesting their own order gets 200
        $this->withToken($tokenA)
            ->getJson('/api/orders/'.$orderA->id)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.id', $orderA->id);

        auth('api')->logout();

        // 2. Customer B requesting Customer A's order gets 403 with exact message
        $tokenB = auth('api')->login($customerB);
        $this->withToken($tokenB)
            ->getJson('/api/orders/'.$orderA->id)
            ->assertStatus(403)
            ->assertJsonPath('message', "You don't have access to this order.");

        auth('api')->logout();

        // 3. Admin can view any order
        $tokenAdmin = auth('api')->login($admin);
        $this->withToken($tokenAdmin)
            ->getJson('/api/orders/'.$orderA->id)
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertJsonPath('data.id', $orderA->id);

        auth('api')->logout();

        // 4. Unauthenticated request gets 401
        $this->getJson('/api/orders/'.$orderA->id)
            ->assertStatus(401);
    }

    public function test_rate_limiting_independent_counters_and_no_cross_blocking(): void
    {
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter::clear('products:127.0.0.1');
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter::clear('categories:127.0.0.1');
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter::clear('register:127.0.0.1');

        $this->makeProduct();

        // Perform requests to products
        for ($i = 0; $i < 60; $i++) {
            $this->getJson('/api/products')->assertOk();
        }

        // 61st request to products should be throttled
        $response = $this->getJson('/api/products');
        $response->assertStatus(429)
            ->assertJsonStructure(['message', 'retry_after'])
            ->assertHeader('Retry-After');

        // Products limit reached should NOT block categories
        $this->getJson('/api/categories')->assertOk();

        // Nor register
        $regResponse = $this->postJson('/api/register', []);
        $this->assertNotSame(429, $regResponse->status());
    }

    public function test_login_failed_attempts_trigger_5_minute_lockout_across_entire_api(): void
    {
        $ip = '192.168.1.100';
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter::clear('login_attempts:'.$ip);
        \Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter::clear('login_lockout:'.$ip);

        $user = User::factory()->create([
            'email' => 'legit@example.test',
            'password' => bcrypt('password123'),
        ]);

        // 1. Successful login does NOT increment failed login attempts
        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->postJson('/api/login', [
                'email' => $user->email,
                'password' => 'password123',
            ])->assertOk();

        $this->assertSame(0, \Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter::attempts('login_attempts:'.$ip));

        // 2. Perform 4 failed login attempts -> returns 401, not locked out yet
        for ($i = 1; $i <= 4; $i++) {
            $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
                ->postJson('/api/login', [
                    'email' => $user->email,
                    'password' => 'wrong-pass-'.$i,
                ])->assertStatus(401);
        }

        // Other endpoints still accessible
        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->getJson('/api/products')
            ->assertOk();

        // 3. 5th failed attempt activates 5-minute lockout
        $fifthResponse = $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->postJson('/api/login', [
                'email' => $user->email,
                'password' => 'wrong-pass-5',
            ]);

        $fifthResponse->assertStatus(429)
            ->assertJsonStructure(['message', 'retry_after'])
            ->assertHeader('Retry-After');

        // 4. Entire API is locked out for this IP during lockout
        // Calling login:
        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->postJson('/api/login', ['email' => $user->email, 'password' => 'password123'])
            ->assertStatus(429);

        // Calling public products:
        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->getJson('/api/products')
            ->assertStatus(429);

        // Calling categories:
        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->getJson('/api/categories')
            ->assertStatus(429);

        // Calling register:
        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->postJson('/api/register', [])
            ->assertStatus(429);

        // Another IP is NOT affected
        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => '192.168.1.101'])
            ->getJson('/api/products')
            ->assertOk();

        // 5. When 5-minute lockout expires, lockout is removed and failed counter is reset
        Carbon::setTestNow(now()->addMinutes(6));

        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->getJson('/api/products')
            ->assertOk();

        $this->withServerVariables(['REMOTE_ADDR' => $ip])
            ->postJson('/api/login', [
                'email' => $user->email,
                'password' => 'password123',
            ])->assertOk();

        Carbon::setTestNow();
    }

    public function test_client_ip_resolution_with_trusted_proxy(): void
    {
        // When client sends X-Forwarded-For through trusted proxy
        $response = $this->withServerVariables([
            'REMOTE_ADDR' => '10.0.0.1', // proxy IP
            'HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR' => '203.0.113.195', // real client IP
        ])->getJson('/api/products');

        $response->assertOk();
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Integration;

use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\OrderService;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use PDO;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class InventoryOrderIntegrationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private ?PDO $inventoryDatabase = null;

    private ?int $inventoryProductId = null;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->inventoryDatabase = $this->connectToDedicatedInventoryTestDatabase();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        if ($this->inventoryDatabase && $this->inventoryProductId !== null) {
            $this->removeInventoryFixtures($this->inventoryProductId);
        }

        $this->inventoryDatabase = null;
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    public function test_order_reserves_mysql_inventory_through_the_real_grpc_service(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $product = $this->makeProduct();
        $this->seedInventory($product->id, 1);
        $key = (string) Str::uuid();
        $token = auth('api')->login($user);

        $before = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/dashboard')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_orders', 0)->json();
        $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.stock', 1);

        $this->withToken($token)
            ->withHeader('Idempotency-Key', $key)
            ->postJson('/api/orders', [
                'items' => [['product_id' => $product->id, 'quantity' => 1]],
            ])
            ->assertCreated();

        $after = $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/dashboard')
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.total_orders', 1)->json();
        $this->withToken($token)->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.stock', 0);
        fwrite(STDOUT, 'DASHBOARD_RESPONSE_CHECK '.json_encode(['before' => $before, 'after' => $after]).PHP_EOL);

        $this->assertSame(1, (int) $this->inventoryQuantity($product->id)['reserved_quantity']);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('inventory_operations', [
            'idempotency_key' => $key,
            'status' => 'completed',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_failed_order_persistence_releases_the_real_mysql_reservation(): void
    {
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $product = $this->makeProduct();
        $this->seedInventory($product->id, 1);
        $key = (string) Str::uuid();

        // Exercise an actual order-persistence failure; notifications now run after commit.
        Order::created(static function (): void {
            throw new RuntimeException('Simulated order persistence failure');
        });

        try {
            app(OrderService::class)->createOrder(
                $user,
                [['product_id' => $product->id, 'quantity' => 1]],
                $key
            );
            $this->fail('The simulated persistence failure should be rethrown.');
        } catch (RuntimeException $exception) {
            $this->assertSame('Simulated order persistence failure', $exception->getMessage());
        }

        $this->assertSame(0, Order::count());
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('inventory_operations', [
            'idempotency_key' => $key,
            'status' => 'compensated',
        ]);
        $this->assertSame(0, (int) $this->inventoryQuantity($product->id)['reserved_quantity']);
    }

    private function connectToDedicatedInventoryTestDatabase(): PDO
    {
        $host = (string) getenv('INVENTORY_TEST_DB_HOST');
        $port = (string) getenv('INVENTORY_TEST_DB_PORT');
        $database = (string) getenv('INVENTORY_TEST_DB_NAME');
        $user = (string) getenv('INVENTORY_TEST_DB_USER');
        $password = getenv('INVENTORY_TEST_DB_PASSWORD');
        if ($password === false) {
            $passwordFile = (string) getenv('INVENTORY_TEST_DB_PASSWORD_FILE');
            $password = rtrim((string) file_get_contents($passwordFile), "\r\n");
        }

        $connection = new PDO(
            "mysql:host={$host};port={$port};dbname={$database};charset=utf8mb4",
            $user,
            $password,
            [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION]
        );
        $identity = $connection->query(
            'SELECT DATABASE() AS database_name, CURRENT_USER() AS database_user'
        )->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);

        if (
            ($identity['database_name'] ?? null) !== 'inventory_test' ||
            ! str_starts_with((string) ($identity['database_user'] ?? ''), 'inventory_test_user@')
        ) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Refusing to alter a non-test inventory database.');
        }

        return $connection;
    }

    private function makeProduct(): Product
    {
        $category = Category::create(['name' => 'MySQL integration category']);

        return Product::create([
            'name' => 'MySQL integration product',
            'price' => '9.99',
            'category_id' => $category->id,
            'is_active' => true,
        ]);
    }

    private function seedInventory(int $productId, int $quantity): void
    {
        $this->inventoryProductId = $productId;
        $this->removeInventoryFixtures($productId);
        $statement = $this->inventoryDatabase->prepare(
            'INSERT INTO inventory_items (product_id, total_quantity, reserved_quantity) VALUES (?, ?, 0)'
        );
        $statement->execute([$productId, $quantity]);
    }

    private function inventoryQuantity(int $productId): array
    {
        $statement = $this->inventoryDatabase->prepare(
            'SELECT total_quantity, reserved_quantity FROM inventory_items WHERE product_id = ?'
        );
        $statement->execute([$productId]);

        return $statement->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC) ?: [];
    }

    private function removeInventoryFixtures(int $productId): void
    {
        $reservations = $this->inventoryDatabase->prepare(
            'DELETE FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id IN
             (SELECT reservation_id FROM reservation_items WHERE product_id = ?)'
        );
        $reservations->execute([$productId]);
        $statement = $this->inventoryDatabase->prepare(
            'DELETE FROM inventory_items WHERE product_id = ?'
        );
        $statement->execute([$productId]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Integration;

use App\Models\Category;
use App\Models\InventoryOperation;
use App\Models\Order;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Services\InventoryGrpcClient;
use App\Services\NotificationService;
use App\Services\OrderService;
use App\Services\ReservationResult;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Artisan;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Mockery;
use RuntimeException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class NotificationAfterCommitTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_notification_failure_keeps_the_committed_order_and_does_not_reserve_again(): void
    {
        $identity = DB::selectOne('SELECT DATABASE() AS name, CURRENT_USER() AS account');
        if ($identity->name !== 'ecommerce_test' || ! str_starts_with($identity->account, 'laravel_test@')) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Refusing to reset a non-test database.');
        }
        // Real commits are required here; RefreshDatabase's outer rollback would defer callbacks.
        Artisan::call('migrate:fresh', ['--force' => true]);
        $user = User::factory()->create();
        $category = Category::create(['name' => 'After-commit category']);
        $product = Product::create(['name' => 'After-commit product', 'price' => '3.00',
            'category_id' => $category->id, 'is_active' => true]);
        $inventory = Mockery::mock(InventoryGrpcClient::class);
        $inventory->shouldReceive('reserveStock')->once()->andReturn(new ReservationResult(true, 'after-commit-reservation'));
        $this->app->instance(InventoryGrpcClient::class, $inventory);
        $notifications = Mockery::mock(NotificationService::class);
        $notifications->shouldReceive('createOrderNotification')->once()->andReturnUsing(function (): void {
            $this->assertSame(0, DB::transactionLevel());
            throw new RuntimeException('Notification storage unavailable');
        });
        $this->app->instance(NotificationService::class, $notifications);
        Log::spy();
        $key = (string) Str::uuid();
        $items = [['product_id' => $product->id, 'quantity' => 1]];
        $order = app(OrderService::class)->createOrder($user, $items, $key);
        $replayed = app(OrderService::class)->createOrder($user, $items, $key);
        $this->assertSame($order->id, $replayed->id);
        $this->assertSame(1, Order::count());
        $this->assertSame('completed', InventoryOperation::where('idempotency_key', $key)->value('status'));
        Log::shouldHaveReceived('error')->once()->withArgs(fn ($message, $context) =>
            $message === 'Order notification failed after commit' && $context['order_id'] === $order->id);
    }
}

"""Reproducible Requirement 3 tooling; executes Docker in Ubuntu WSL."""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import statistics

sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace')

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LINUX_ROOT = '/mnt/e/projects/internet-applications'
OUT = ROOT / 'docs/performance'

def docker(*args, input=None, check=True):
    raw = subprocess.run(['wsl.exe', '-d', 'Ubuntu', '--', 'docker', *args],
                         input=input.encode('utf-8') if input is not None else None, capture_output=True)
    result = subprocess.CompletedProcess(raw.args, raw.returncode,
        raw.stdout.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), raw.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'))
    if check and result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(f'Docker {args[0]} exited {result.returncode}: '+result.stdout + result.stderr)
    return result

def compose(*args, **kwargs):
    return docker('compose', '--project-directory', LINUX_ROOT, *args, **kwargs)

def redact(text):
    for secret in (ROOT/'secrets').glob('*password*.txt'):
        value=secret.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip()
        if len(value)>4: text=text.replace(value, '[REDACTED TEST SECRET]')
    return text

def save(path, text):
    path = OUT / path
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(redact(text), encoding='utf-8')

def php(code):
    return docker('exec', '-i', 'ecommerce-backend', 'php', input=r'''<?php
require '/var/www/html/vendor/autoload.php';
$app = require '/var/www/html/bootstrap/app.php';
$app->make(Illuminate\Contracts\Console\Kernel::class)->bootstrap();
''' + code).stdout

def counts():
    return php("foreach (['users','products','orders','order_items'] as $table) echo $table.': '.Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\DB::table($table)->count().PHP_EOL;")

def api(path, email=None, token=None, method='GET', body=None, headers=None):
    if email:
        password='admin123456' if email=='admin@example.com' else 'password123'
        token=api('/login',method='POST',body={'email':email,'password':password})['access_token']
    hdr={'Accept':'application/json','Content-Type':'application/json', **(headers or {})}
    if token: hdr['Authorization']='Bearer '+token
    request=urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:8000/api'+path,
        data=json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None,headers=hdr,method=method)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(request,timeout=30) as response:
        return json.load(response)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    command = sys.argv[1]
    if command == 'init':
        (OUT/'baseline').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        (OUT/'results').mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for name,args in [('git-status-start.txt',['git','status','--short']),('git-diff-start.txt',['git','diff','--stat'])]:
            r=subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8')
            save('baseline/'+name,r.stdout+r.stderr)
        save('baseline/environment.txt',compose('version').stdout+compose('images').stdout+docker('info','--format','{{.OperatingSystem}} CPUs={{.NCPU}} RAM={{.MemTotal}}').stdout)
        save('baseline/initial-counts.txt',counts())
        instructions=(ROOT/'AGENT_INSTRUCTIONS_REQUIREMENT_3.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        seeder=instructions.split('## Appendix C')[1].split('```php\n',1)[1].split('```',1)[0]
        (ROOT/'backend/my-project/database/seeders/BulkOrderSeeder.php').write_text(seeder,encoding='utf-8')
        docker('cp',LINUX_ROOT+'/backend/my-project/database/seeders/BulkOrderSeeder.php','ecommerce-backend:/var/www/html/database/seeders/BulkOrderSeeder.php')
        print(counts())
    elif command == 'seed':
        started=time.monotonic()
        result=compose('exec','-T','-e','BULK_ORDER_COUNT=300000','backend','php','artisan','db:seed','--class=BulkOrderSeeder',check=False)
        text=result.stdout+result.stderr+f'\nElapsed seconds: {time.monotonic()-started:.6f}\nExit code: {result.returncode}\n'+counts()
        save('baseline/dataset.txt',text)
        print(text)
        sys.exit(result.returncode)
    elif command == 'explain':
        queries=[
            'SELECT * FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15',
            'SELECT * FROM products WHERE is_active = 1 AND category_id = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15',
            'SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = USER_ID ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15',
            "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'shipped' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15",
            'SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 15',
            "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status <> 'cancelled'",
        ]
        code='$userId = Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\DB::table("orders")->selectRaw("user_id, COUNT(*) AS n")->groupBy("user_id")->orderByDesc("n")->value("user_id");\n'
        for q in queries:
            code+='$sql = str_replace("USER_ID", (string)$userId, '+json.dumps(q)+'); echo $sql.PHP_EOL; foreach (["EXPLAIN ","EXPLAIN ANALYZE "] as $prefix) { echo json_encode(Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\DB::select($prefix.$sql), JSON_PRETTY_PRINT).PHP_EOL; }\n'
        code+='foreach (["products","orders"] as $table) echo "INDEXES ".$table.PHP_EOL.json_encode(Illuminate\\Support\\Facades\\DB::select("SHOW INDEX FROM ".$table),JSON_PRETTY_PRINT).PHP_EOL;'
        result=php(code)
        save(sys.argv[2],result)
        print(result[:2500])
    elif command == 'setup-tests':
        args=['-f',LINUX_ROOT+'/docker-compose.yml','-f',LINUX_ROOT+'/perf/tests.compose.yml','--profile','mysql-integration']
        result=compose(*args,'up','-d','--no-build','mysql-integration','inventory-mysql-integration','inventory-service-integration',check=False)
        save('baseline/test-stack.txt',result.stdout+result.stderr)
        print(result.stdout+result.stderr)
        if result.returncode: sys.exit(result.returncode)
        result=compose(*args,'run','-d','--no-deps','--name','requirement3-tests','--entrypoint','sleep','backend-test','infinity')
        print(result.stdout)
    elif command == 'snapshot':
        bodies={email:api('/dashboard',email=email) for email in ['admin@example.com','bulk-customer-1@example.test','bulk-customer-2@example.test']}
        save(sys.argv[2],json.dumps(bodies,indent=2))
        print(json.dumps(bodies,indent=2))
    elif command == 'repair-runtime':
        for source,target in [('app/.','app'),('routes/.','routes'),('config/.','config'),('bootstrap/app.php','bootstrap/app.php'),('database/.','database'),('composer.json','composer.json'),('composer.lock','composer.lock')]:
            docker('cp',LINUX_ROOT+'/backend/my-project/'+source,'ecommerce-backend:/var/www/html/'+target)
        r=compose('exec','-T','backend','composer','install','--no-dev','--no-interaction','--no-scripts',check=False)
        save('baseline/dependency-repair.txt',r.stdout+r.stderr)
        print(redact(r.stdout+r.stderr))
        sys.exit(r.returncode)

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Product;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;

class ProductCache
{
    public function get(int $id): ?array
    {
        $value = Cache::get("product:{$id}:details");

        return is_array($value) ? $value : null;
    }

    public function put(Product $product): void
    {
        $product->loadMissing('category');
        $attributes = $product->toArray();
        // Stock must never enter this cache, even if a caller already loaded it.
        unset($attributes['stock']);
        Cache::put("product:{$product->id}:details", $attributes, 300);
    }

    public function forget(int $id): void
    {
        Cache::forget("product:{$id}:details");
    }
}

        source=r'''<?php

namespace App\Http\Middleware;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Http\JsonResponse;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

class ConditionalGet
{
    public function handle(Request $request, Closure $next): Response
    {
        $response = $next($request);
        if ($request->isMethod('GET') && $response instanceof JsonResponse && $response->getStatusCode() === 200) {
            // Compute after rendering: the representation still includes live stock.
            $response->setEtag('"'.sha1($response->getContent()).'"');
            $response->headers->set('Cache-Control', 'private, no-cache');
            $response->isNotModified($request);
        }

        return $response;
    }
}
'''

        $first = $this->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)->assertOk();
        $etag = $first->headers->get('ETag');
        $this->assertNotEmpty($etag);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('private', $first->headers->get('Cache-Control'));

        $this->withHeader('If-None-Match', $etag)->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)
            ->assertStatus(304)->assertContent('');
        $last = $this->withHeader('If-None-Match', $etag)->getJson('/api/products/'.$product->id)
            ->assertOk()->assertJsonPath('data.stock', 8);
        $this->assertNotSame($etag, $last->headers->get('ETag'));
    }

import base64
import json
import requirement3 as r

def inventory(mode, product_id, keys):
    code='''
const fs=require('node:fs'); const mysql=require('mysql2/promise');
(async()=>{
const c=await mysql.createConnection({host:process.env.DB_HOST,port:Number(process.env.DB_PORT||3306),
user:process.env.DB_USER,database:process.env.DB_NAME,password:fs.readFileSync(process.env.DB_PASSWORD_FILE,'utf8').trimEnd()});
const [[identity]]=await c.query('SELECT DATABASE() AS db,CURRENT_USER() AS account');
if(identity.db!=='inventory_db'||!identity.account.startsWith('inventory_service@'))throw new Error('Unexpected inventory database');
const id=PRODUCT_ID,keys=KEYS;
if(MODE==='create'){
const [existing]=await c.execute('SELECT product_id FROM inventory_items WHERE product_id=?',[id]);
if(existing.length)throw new Error('Refusing to overwrite existing inventory');
await c.execute('INSERT INTO inventory_items (product_id,total_quantity,reserved_quantity) VALUES (?,10,0)',[id]);
}else{
const [reservations]=keys.length?await c.execute('SELECT reservation_id FROM reservations WHERE idempotency_key IN ('+keys.map(()=>'?').join(',')+')',keys):[[]];
const ids=reservations.map(x=>x.reservation_id);
const [items]=await c.execute('SELECT reservation_id FROM reservation_items WHERE product_id=?',[id]);
if(items.some(x=>!ids.includes(x.reservation_id)))throw new Error('Unowned reservation references fixture');
const [[stock]]=await c.execute('SELECT reserved_quantity FROM inventory_items WHERE product_id=?',[id]);
if(stock&&Number(stock.reserved_quantity)!==0)throw new Error('Fixture stock is still reserved');
for(const reservation of ids){await c.execute('DELETE FROM reservation_items WHERE reservation_id=?',[reservation]);await c.execute('DELETE FROM reservations WHERE reservation_id=?',[reservation]);}
await c.execute('DELETE FROM inventory_items WHERE product_id=?',[id]);
}
await c.end();console.log('Inventory fixture '+MODE+' complete');
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)});

(async()=>{

const [[identity]]=await c.query('SELECT DATABASE() AS db,CURRENT_USER() AS account');

const id=PRODUCT_ID,keys=KEYS;
if(MODE==='create'){
const [existing]=await c.execute('SELECT product_id FROM inventory_items WHERE product_id=?',[id]);
if(existing.length)throw new Error('Refusing to overwrite existing inventory');
await c.execute('INSERT INTO inventory_items (product_id,total_quantity,reserved_quantity) VALUES (?,10,0)',[id]);
}else{
const [reservations]=keys.length?await c.execute('SELECT reservation_id FROM reservations WHERE idempotency_key IN ('+keys.map(()=>'?').join(',')+')',keys):[[]];
const ids=reservations.map(x=>x.reservation_id);
const [items]=await c.execute('SELECT reservation_id FROM reservation_items WHERE product_id=?',[id]);

if(stock&&Number(stock.reserved_quantity)!==0)throw new Error('Fixture stock is still reserved');

await c.execute('DELETE FROM inventory_items WHERE product_id=?',[id]);
}
await c.end();console.log('Inventory fixture '+MODE+' complete');
})().catch(e=>{console.error(e.message);process.exit(1)});
'''.replace('PRODUCT_ID',str(int(product_id))).replace('KEYS',json.dumps(keys)).replace('MODE',json.dumps(mode))
    return r.docker('exec','-i','ecommerce-inventory','node',input=code).stdout

def clean(fixture):
    if not fixture.get('product_id'):return
    for order_id in ([] if fixture.get('orders_cancelled') else fixture.get('order_ids',[])):
        order=r.api('/orders/'+str(order_id),email='admin@example.com')['data']
        if order['status']!='cancelled':
            r.api('/admin/orders/'+str(order_id)+'/status',email='admin@example.com',method='PATCH',body={'status':'cancelled'})
    if fixture.get('inventory_created'):inventory('delete',fixture['product_id'],fixture.get('keys',[]))
    encoded=base64.b64encode(json.dumps(fixture).encode()).decode()
    code=r'''
$fixture=json_decode(base64_decode('ENCODED'),true);
$product=App\Models\Product::withTrashed()->find($fixture['product_id']);
if (!$product || $product->name!==$fixture['name']) throw new RuntimeException('Fixture ownership check failed');
Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::transaction(function () use ($fixture,$product) {
    $operations=App\Models\InventoryOperation::whereIn('idempotency_key',$fixture['keys'])->get();
    $orders=$operations->pluck('order_id')->filter()->all();
    $customer=App\Models\User::where('email','customer@example.com')->firstOrFail();
    foreach (App\Models\Order::whereIn('id',$orders)->get() as $order) {
        if ($order->user_id!==$customer->id) throw new RuntimeException('Unowned order');
    }
    Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('notifications')->where('notifiable_id',$customer->id)->whereIn('data->order_id',$orders)->delete();
    App\Models\FailedCompensation::whereIn('operation_id',$operations->pluck('id'))->delete();
    App\Models\InventoryOperation::whereIn('id',$operations->pluck('id'))->delete();
    Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB::table('order_items')->whereIn('order_id',$orders)->delete();
    App\Models\Order::whereIn('id',$orders)->delete();
    $product->forceDelete();
    app(App\Services\ProductCache::class)->forget($fixture['product_id']);
    App\Services\DashboardCache::forgetCache($customer->id);
});
echo 'Owned API fixtures removed'.PHP_EOL;
'''.replace('ENCODED',encoded)
    print(r.php(code),flush=True)
    r.save('results/live-api-cleanup-counts.txt',r.counts())

    try:
        _,admin_before,_=request('GET','/dashboard',admin)
        _,customer_before,_=request('GET','/dashboard',customer)

        detail='/products/'+str(fixture['product_id'])
        status,value,_=request('GET',detail,customer)

        status,_,_=request('PATCH',detail,admin,{'price':'1.25'})
        assert status==200
        status,value,head=request('GET',detail,customer)

                'stock_error':stock_body,'order_error':order_body}

        assert status==201,(status,created)
        order_id=created['data']['id'];fixture['order_ids']=[order_id]
        r.save('results/live-api-fixture.json',json.dumps(fixture))
        status,replayed,_=request('POST','/orders',customer,payload,{'Idempotency-Key':key})
        assert status==201 and replayed['data']['id']==order_id
        _,customer_after,_=request('GET','/dashboard',customer)
        assert customer_after['data']['total_orders']==customer_before['data']['total_orders']+1
        status,value,head=request('GET',detail,customer,headers={'If-None-Match':etag})
        assert status==200 and value['data']['stock']==9 and head['ETag']!=etag
        result['checks']['retry_same_key_one_order']=True
        result['checks']['dashboard_before_after_order']={'before':customer_before,'after':customer_after}
        result['checks']['stock_after_order']=9
        new_etag=head['ETag']
        status,cancelled,_=request('PATCH','/admin/orders/'+str(order_id)+'/status',admin,{'status':'cancelled'})
        assert status==200 and cancelled['data']['status']=='cancelled'
        fixture['orders_cancelled']=True
        _,admin_cancelled,_=request('GET','/dashboard',admin)
        assert Decimal(admin_cancelled['data']['total_sales'])==Decimal(admin_before['data']['total_sales'])
        status,value,head=request('GET',detail,customer,headers={'If-None-Match':new_etag})
        assert status==200 and value['data']['stock']==10 and head['ETag']!=new_etag
        result['checks']['stock_after_cancellation']=10
        status,_,_=request('DELETE',detail,admin)
        assert status==200
        _,admin_deleted,_=request('GET','/dashboard',admin)
        assert admin_deleted['data']['total_products']==admin_before['data']['total_products']
        status,_,_=request('GET',detail,customer)
        assert status==404
        result['checks']['delete_refreshes_dashboard_and_detail']=True
        result['passed']=True
        r.save('results/live-api-verification.json',json.dumps(result,indent=2))
        print(json.dumps(result,indent=2),flush=True)
    finally:
        r.compose('up','-d','--no-build','--wait','--wait-timeout','120','inventory-service')
        clean(fixture)

"""Capture final read-only runtime evidence and the complete working-tree state."""
import json
import re
import subprocess
import urllib.request
from requirement3 import ROOT, OUT, compose, counts, docker, save

request = urllib.request.Request('http://localhost:8000/api/products/1', method='OPTIONS', headers={
    'Origin': 'http://localhost:5173', 'Access-Control-Request-Method': 'GET',
    'Access-Control-Request-Headers': 'authorization,content-type,if-none-match'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30) as response:
    cors = {'status': response.status, 'headers': dict(response.headers)}
save('results/cors-preflight.json', json.dumps(cors, indent=2))
health = {}
for url in ['http://localhost:8000/up', 'http://localhost:5173']:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=30) as response:
        health[url] = response.status
save('results/final-health.json', json.dumps(health, indent=2))
save('results/final-counts.txt', counts())
save('results/final-runtime.txt', compose('version').stdout + compose('ps').stdout +
     docker('info', '--format', '{{.OperatingSystem}} CPUs={{.NCPU}} RAM={{.MemTotal}}').stdout)

for name, args in [('git-status-end.txt', ['status', '--short']),
                   ('git-diff-end.txt', ['diff', '--stat']),
                   ('git-diff-check.txt', ['diff', '--check']),
                   ('inventory-source-diff.txt', ['diff', '--', 'inventory-service']),
                   ('changed-files.txt', ['diff', '--name-only'])]:
    result = subprocess.run(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, encoding='utf-8')
    save('results/' + name, result.stdout + result.stderr)
    if name == 'git-diff-check.txt' and result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError('git diff --check failed: see raw output')
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'], cwd=ROOT,
                        capture_output=True, encoding='utf-8')
save('results/new-files.txt', result.stdout)

decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
plans = {}
for stage, filename in [('before', 'baseline/explain-before.txt'),
                         ('after', 'results/after-indexes/explain-after.txt')]:
    content = (OUT / filename).read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    rows = []
    cursor = 0
    for _ in range(6):
        query_end = content.index('\n', cursor)
        query = content[cursor:query_end].strip()
        cursor = query_end + 1
        traditional, length = decoder.raw_decode(content[cursor:])
        cursor += length
        while content[cursor].isspace(): cursor += 1
        analysis, length = decoder.raw_decode(content[cursor:])
        cursor += length
        while cursor < len(content) and content[cursor].isspace(): cursor += 1
        plan = analysis[0]['EXPLAIN']
        actual = re.findall(r'actual time=([\d.]+)\.\.([\d.]+) rows=([\d.]+) loops=(\d+)', plan)
        rows.append({'query': query, 'type': traditional[0]['type'], 'key': traditional[0]['key'],
                     'estimated_rows': traditional[0]['rows'], 'leaf_actual_rows': actual[-1][2],
                     'leaf_loops': actual[-1][3], 'root_completion_ms': actual[0][1]})
    plans[stage] = rows
save('results/explain-summary.json', json.dumps(plans, indent=2))
print(json.dumps({'health': health, 'cors': cors, 'plans': plans}, indent=2))

## Measurements

{measurements}

Products and orders sometimes became slower after indexes; no improvement is claimed for those stages. ETags primarily saved response bytes: product detail median received bytes changed from 182,569 after metadata caching to 112,267 after ETags, with 64 conditional hits. Detail p95 was 30.677 ms versus 31.550 ms, so no latency benefit is claimed. Scenarios were rerun only when relevant to the change; omitted cells are not measured.

Both backend suites were run after each applied backend task; each stage retains its test output. The single skip exercises an absent gRPC extension, whereas this environment has it. After-commit integration uses actual commits and proves notification failure at level 0 keeps one completed order and replays without another reservation. Original compensation checks now fail the order write rather than notification creation, retaining rollback/stock-release coverage.

Notification timing uses a synthetic 50 ms notification delay, three runs per side, in guarded test schemas with fake reservation confirmation. These are median milliseconds, not production HTTP timings or complete lock-duration measurements:

|---|---|---|

Notification transaction levels were [1,1,1] before and [0,0,0] after. Time moved out of the persistence transaction body; overall synchronous order-call time is essentially unchanged. Final backend/scheduler images were rebuilt and deployed, followed by health and ETag checks. Key source-file SHA-256 hashes match the working source in both images (`results/final-source-verification.json`). ## Problems and deviations

{problems}

## Decisions

T8: standard body-based ETag completed; live gRPC still runs before every product-detail response, including 304. The advanced stock-version/skip-gRPC alternative was not implemented.
T9: user reopened the earlier rollback answer, then delegated the accurate/reasonable choice. Selected after-commit creation with error logging; a notification failure preserves the committed order. Earlier rollback choice superseded. No automatic notification retry/queue was added.
T10: user explicitly chose to defer the read replica after reviewing the measured results; no replica was added.
T11: user explicitly chose to keep current pagination totals; existing API and frontend pagination contracts are retained.
T13: user explicitly chose to keep the current development server; artisan serve and current OPcache settings are retained. This is a development choice, not a production deployment recommendation. All behavior decisions are resolved.
T16: user approved A–D; implemented and checked. E was unnecessary because UTF-8 Arabic source was already correct.

## Frontend review

1. Contracts: existing endpoints, JSON envelopes, pagination totals and dashboard types preserved; total_sales remains string and total_users nullable. Backend response comparisons passed.
2. Freshness: T15 found missing dashboard/stock invalidation. Approved T16 now invalidates dashboard, order lists and product details after order create/status changes. Product create/delete refresh dashboard; delete refreshes details. The existing two-minute query staleTime remains.
3. Conditional requests: API client has no no-store setting. Browser revalidation is possible; React Query still controls when requests occur. Private/no-cache ETags do not bypass live stock.
4. Stock unavailable: existing product page recognizes 503 and shows the inventory-unavailable state. Live conditional GET correctly returns 503 while inventory is stopped.
5. Base URL stays `http://localhost:8000/api`. Project `config/cors.php` is absent; actual preflight allows Origin `*` and requested bearer-auth/conditional headers. The compose CORS setting is not asserted as an effective origin restriction.
6. Idempotency: API now requires an explicit key. ProductDetails retains one key for the same item attempt across failures, resets after success and changes it when quantity/product changes. Component tests cover these paths; live API confirms one order for same-key replay.
7. Encoding: Arabic is valid UTF-8 and unchanged. UI build/lint passed. Component tests use controlled API fixtures plus actual query/mutation hooks; real API/gRPC verification is separate. Brave UI flow was not performed due to policy rejection.

## Trade-offs and limitations

Dashboard TTL is 60 seconds. Order writes invalidate the affected customer and shared admin entry; product writes clear admin counts. Other customers' global counts can remain old until TTL. Product metadata TTL is 300 seconds: only category relation is reused; route binding controls current price/visibility, and stock is never cached. Category changes outside ProductService may wait for TTL.
Every product detail, including 304, calls inventory live. Redis uses the requested 512mb/allkeys-lru; memory pressure can evict rate-limiter/lockout counters. Notification failures are logged without automatic delivery retries. Existing response shapes and pagination totals are retained.
The test uses a paced 5-VU workload, not production capacity. WSL restarts and host-memory pressure occurred between stages, so small latency differences are not statistically established. Opcache CLI remains 0 and artisan serve remains a development server. Replica consistency, total-free pagination and nginx/FPM performance are not measured. Full browser validation remains outstanding.

## How to reproduce

Run from `E:\\projects\\internet-applications` in PowerShell with Ubuntu/native Docker running. The existing deployment already contains every approved change. Do not rerun seed/apply commands on this populated database. `perf/README.md` explains safe current-state checks and the historical ladder, including the isolated source/database requirement for a fresh baseline.
Current-state verification commands (previously run in this order of dependency; the test container must be running):
```powershell
python perf/requirement3.py tests after-notifications
python perf/requirement3.py frontend-checks
python perf/requirement3.py verify-pagination
python perf/requirement3.py verify-etag
python perf/api_write_verify.py
Set-Location perf/ui-tests
npm.cmd install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
$env:RAYON_NUM_THREADS='1'
$env:UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE='1'
$env:NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=768'
npm.cmd exec -- vitest run --reporter=json --outputFile=E:/projects/internet-applications/docs/performance/results/frontend-component-tests.json
Set-Location ../..
python perf/final_checks.py
```
The MySQL suite/timing harness reset only the dedicated `ecommerce_test` schema after checking database/account identity. Live API checks briefly stop inventory, restore it in finally, and delete only tagged fixtures; run when no other user is placing orders. Repeated load runs overwrite that stage's files; copy evidence first. No migration rollback was tested.

# Reuse the existing PHP/gRPC runtime; only install development dependencies.
FROM internet-applications-backend:latest

    && composer dump-autoload --no-scripts
RUN php artisan package:discover --no-ansi

بناء Redis فوق صورة PHP الحالية

ملف جديد

perf/Dockerfile.redis-runtime

تعيد استخدام صورة PHP/gRPC المقاسة، وتضيف Redis والاعتمادات الحالية دون إعادة تجميع gRPC الطويلة.

هذا مسار بناء محلي موثق؛ Dockerfile الأساسي حصل أيضًا على إضافة امتداد Redis.

الكود الكامل للملف الجديد.

الكود الفعلي · للقراءة والنسخ
# Preserve the measured PHP/gRPC runtime and add only Redis plus current source.
FROM requirement3-runtime:before-redis
RUN pecl install redis && docker-php-ext-enable redis
WORKDIR /var/www/html
COPY composer.json composer.lock ./
RUN composer install --no-dev --no-interaction --no-scripts --optimize-autoloader
COPY . .
RUN composer run-script post-autoload-dump \
    && mkdir -p storage/framework/cache/data storage/framework/sessions storage/framework/views storage/logs bootstrap/cache \
    && chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache

إعداد jsdom وتوحيد مسارات الوحدات

ملف جديد

perf/ui-tests/vitest.config.ts

يضبط بيئة DOM وعاملًا واحدًا ومسارات @ وReact وRouter وLucide. يستخدم file URL للاستيراد الديناميكي على Windows.

عالجت المسارات الصريحة فشل أداة الاختبار حين استخدم Router نسخة غير مشمولة بالمحاكاة. هذا إصلاح للحاضنة وليس تغييرًا في سلوك التطبيق.

الكود الكامل للملف الجديد.

الكود الفعلي · للقراءة والنسخ
import { defineConfig } from 'vitest/config'
import { createRequire } from 'node:module'
import path from 'node:path'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

const frontend = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, '../../frontend')
const frontendRequire = createRequire(path.join(frontend, 'package.json'))
const react = await import(pathToFileURL(frontendRequire.resolve('@vitejs/plugin-react')).href)

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [react.default()],
  resolve: { alias: {
    '@': path.join(frontend, 'src'),
    react: path.join(frontend, 'node_modules/react'),
    'react-dom': path.join(frontend, 'node_modules/react-dom'),
    '@tanstack/react-query': path.join(frontend, 'node_modules/@tanstack/react-query'),
    '@tanstack/react-router': path.join(frontend, 'node_modules/@tanstack/react-router'),
    'lucide-react': path.join(frontend, 'node_modules/lucide-react'),
  } },
  test: { environment: 'jsdom', maxWorkers: 1, fileParallelism: false, testTimeout: 15000,
    include: ['performance-ui.test.tsx'] },
})

ثلاثة سيناريوهات واجهة بمكوّنات وhooks فعلية

ملف جديد

perf/ui-tests/performance-ui.test.tsx

يتحقق من ثبات مفتاح المحاولة الفاشلة، وتغييره عند اختلاف المنتج أو الكمية، وتحديث الداشبورد والطلبات والمخزون والقوائم بعد الكتابة.

API في هذه الحاضنة محاكاة مضبوطة، بينما المكوّن وReact Query hooks فعليان. فحص API الحقيقي منفصل؛ هذه الاختبارات ليست جلسة متصفح كاملة.

مقتطف من الملف الجديد؛ الكود الكامل متاح أدناه.

import React from 'react'
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
import { act, cleanup, configure, fireEvent, render, renderHook, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react'
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query'
import { writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import path from 'node:path'

const mocks = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  orders: { create:vi.fn(), getMine:vi.fn(), getById:vi.fn(), adminGetAll:vi.fn(), adminUpdateStatus:vi.fn() },
  products: { getById:vi.fn(), getAll:vi.fn(), create:vi.fn(), update:vi.fn(), delete:vi.fn() },
  dashboard: { getSummary:vi.fn() }, navigate:vi.fn(),
}))
vi.mock('@/features/orders/api/orders.api', () => ({ ordersApi:mocks.orders }))
vi.mock('@/features/products/api/products.api', () => ({ productsApi:mocks.products }))
vi.mock('@/features/dashboard/api/dashboard.api', () => ({ dashboardApi:mocks.dashboard }))
vi.mock('@/features/auth/stores/auth.store', () => ({ useAuthStore:(selector:any)=>selector({user:{role:'customer'}}) }))
vi.mock('@/lib/toast', () => ({ toastService:{success:vi.fn(),error:vi.fn()} }))
vi.mock('@tanstack/react-router', () => ({ useNavigate:()=>mocks.navigate,
  Link:({children,to}:any)=><a href={to}>{children}</a> }))
vi.mock('lucide-react', () => ({ Pencil:()=>null, ArrowRight:()=>null, ShoppingCart:()=>null }))
vi.mock('@/components/ui/button', () => ({ Button:({children,asChild,...props}:any)=>
  asChild ? React.cloneElement(children,props) : <button {...props}>{children}</button> }))
vi.mock('@/components/ui/input', () => ({ Input:(props:any)=><input {...props}/> }))
vi.mock('@/components/ui/badge', () => ({ Badge:({children}:any)=><span>{children}</span> }))
vi.mock('@/components/ui/card', () => ({ Card:({children}:any)=><div>{children}</div>,
  CardContent:({children}:any)=><div>{children}</div>, CardHeader:({children}:any)=><div>{children}</div>,
  CardTitle:({children}:any)=><h2>{children}</h2> }))
vi.mock('@/components/feedback/loading-spinner', () => ({ LoadingSpinner:({text}:any)=><div>{text}</div> }))
vi.mock('@/components/feedback/empty-state', () => ({ EmptyState:({title}:any)=><div>{title}</div> }))

import { ProductDetails } from '@/features/products/components/product-details'
import { useOrders, useUpdateOrderStatus } from '@/features/orders/hooks/use-orders'
import { useDashboard } from '@/features/dashboard/hooks/use-dashboard'
import { useProducts, useCreateProduct, useDeleteProduct } from '@/features/products/hooks/use-products'

configure({ asyncUtilTimeout:5000 })
const evidence:any = { scope:'jsdom components and real query/mutation hooks; API functions replaced by controlled fixtures' }
const clients:QueryClient[]=[]
let state:any
const clone = (value:any)=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(value))
const product = (id:number)=>({id,name:`Fixture product ${id}`,description:'Verification fixture',price:'1.00',
  image_url:null,category:{id:1,name:'Fixture category'},is_active:true,stock:10,
  created_at:'2026-11-07T00:00:00.000000Z',updated_at:'2026-11-07T00:00:00.000000Z'})
const page = (data:any[])=>({data:clone(data),meta:{current_page:1,last_page:1,per_page:15,total:data.length},links:{}})
function context(){
  const client=new QueryClient({defaultOptions:{queries:{retry:false,staleTime:120000,gcTime:0},mutations:{retry:false}}})
  clients.push(client)
  return {client,wrapper:({children}:any)=><QueryClientProvider client={client}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>}
}

beforeEach(()=>{
  vi.resetAllMocks()
  state={products:{1:product(1)},orders:[],failNext:0,dashboard:{total_products:1,total_orders:0,orders_today:0,total_users:null,total_sales:'0.00'}}
  mocks.dashboard.getSummary.mockImplementation(async()=>clone(state.dashboard))
  mocks.products.getById.mockImplementation(async(id)=>{
    if(!state.products[id])throw {statusCode:404,message:'Not found'}
    return clone(state.products[id])
  })
  mocks.products.getAll.mockImplementation(async()=>page(Object.values(state.products)))
  mocks.orders.getMine.mockImplementation(async()=>page(state.orders))
  mocks.orders.adminGetAll.mockImplementation(async()=>page(state.orders))
  mocks.orders.getById.mockImplementation(async(id)=>clone(state.orders.find((order:any)=>order.id===id)))
  mocks.orders.create.mockImplementation(async(items)=>{
    if(state.failNext>0){state.failNext--;throw {statusCode:503,message:'Inventory unavailable'}}
    const order={id:100+state.orders.length,status:'pending',total:'1.00',items:[]}
    state.orders.push(order);state.products[items[0].product_id].stock-=items[0].quantity
    state.dashboard.total_orders++;state.dashboard.orders_today++;state.dashboard.total_sales='1.00'
    return clone(order)
  })
  mocks.orders.adminUpdateStatus.mockImplementation(async(id,status)=>{
    const order=state.orders.find((order:any)=>order.id===id);order.status=status
    state.products[1].stock=10;state.dashboard.total_sales='0.00';return clone(order)
  })
  mocks.products.create.mockImplementation(async(input)=>{
    const value={...product(2),...input,id:2};state.products[2]=value;state.dashboard.total_products++
    return clone(value)
  })
  mocks.products.delete.mockImplementation(async(id)=>{delete state.products[id];state.dashboard.total_products--})
})
afterEach(()=>{cleanup();clients.splice(0).forEach(client=>client.clear())})
afterAll(()=>{
  const folder=path.resolve(import.meta.dirname,'../../docs/performance/results')
  mkdirSync(folder,{recursive:true});writeFileSync(path.join(folder,'frontend-component-evidence.json'),JSON.stringify(evidence,null,2))
})

describe('Requirement 3 approved frontend behavior',()=>{
  it('reuses a failed order key and refreshes dashboard, order list and live stock after writes',async()=>{
    const {wrapper}=context()
    const dashboard=renderHook(()=>useDashboard(),{wrapper})
    const orders=renderHook(()=>useOrders(1),{wrapper})
    render(<ProductDetails productId={1}/>,{wrapper})
    await screen.findByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'})
    await waitFor(()=>expect(dashboard.result.current.data?.total_orders).toBe(0))
    state.failNext=1
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'}))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(mocks.orders.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'}).hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(false))
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'}))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(dashboard.result.current.data?.total_orders).toBe(1))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(orders.result.current.data?.meta.total).toBe(1))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(screen.getByText('المخزون المتوفر').nextElementSibling?.textContent).toBe('9'))
    const keys=mocks.orders.create.mock.calls.map(call=>call[1])
    expect(keys).toHaveLength(2);expect(keys[0]).toBeTruthy();expect(keys[1]).toBe(keys[0]);expect(state.orders).toHaveLength(1)
    const update=renderHook(()=>useUpdateOrderStatus(100),{wrapper})
    await act(async()=>{await update.result.current.mutateAsync('cancelled')})
    await waitFor(()=>expect(dashboard.result.current.data?.total_sales).toBe('0.00'))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(orders.result.current.data?.data[0].status).toBe('cancelled'))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(screen.getByText('المخزون المتوفر').nextElementSibling?.textContent).toBe('10'))
    evidence.orderRetry={sameKey:keys[0]===keys[1],ordersCreated:state.orders.length,
      dashboardOrders:dashboard.result.current.data?.total_orders,stockAfterOrder:9,stockAfterCancellation:10,
      salesAfterCancellation:dashboard.result.current.data?.total_sales}
  })

  it('changes the retry key when quantity or the product changes',async()=>{
    const {wrapper}=context();state.failNext=3;state.products[2]=product(2)
    const view=render(<ProductDetails productId={1}/>,{wrapper})
    await screen.findByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'})
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'}))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(mocks.orders.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'}).hasAttribute('disabled')).toBe(false))
    fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText('الكمية'),{target:{value:'2'}})
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'}))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(mocks.orders.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2))
    view.rerender(<ProductDetails productId={2}/>)
    await screen.findByText('Fixture product 2')
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button',{name:'اطلب الآن'}))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(mocks.orders.create).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3))
    const calls=mocks.orders.create.mock.calls
    expect(new Set(calls.map(call=>call[1])).size).toBe(3)
    expect(calls[1][0]).toEqual([{product_id:1,quantity:2}])
    expect(calls[2][0]).toEqual([{product_id:2,quantity:2}])
    evidence.changedItems={distinctKeys:3,quantityChangeCreatesKey:true,productChangeCreatesKey:true}
  })

  it('refreshes dashboard and product queries after creating and deleting products',async()=>{
    const {wrapper}=context()
    const dashboard=renderHook(()=>useDashboard(),{wrapper})
    const products=renderHook(()=>useProducts(),{wrapper})
    const create=renderHook(()=>useCreateProduct(),{wrapper})
    const remove=renderHook(()=>useDeleteProduct(),{wrapper})
    render(<ProductDetails productId={1}/>,{wrapper})
    await screen.findByText('Fixture product 1')
    await waitFor(()=>expect(dashboard.result.current.data?.total_products).toBe(1))
    await act(async()=>{await create.result.current.mutateAsync({name:'Added fixture',price:2,category_id:1,is_active:true})})
    await waitFor(()=>expect(dashboard.result.current.data?.total_products).toBe(2))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(products.result.current.data?.meta.total).toBe(2))
    await act(async()=>{await remove.result.current.mutateAsync(1)})
    await waitFor(()=>expect(dashboard.result.current.data?.total_products).toBe(1))
    await waitFor(()=>expect(products.result.current.data?.meta.total).toBe(1))
    await screen.findByText('المنتج غير موجود')
    expect(mocks.products.getById.mock.calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(1)
    evidence.productWrites={dashboardAfterCreate:2,dashboardAfterDelete:1,deletedDetailRefetched:true}
  })
})

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = ROOT / 'CHANGES_EXPLAINED_AR.html'
BASE = 'backend/my-project/'

def backend(path):
    return BASE + path

# Explanation text is Arabic at the user's explicit request; embedded code is unchanged.

(backend('app/Http/Middleware/ConditionalGet.php'), 'إنشاء ETag بعد تجهيز استجابة JSON', 'بعد تنفيذ المسار، نتعامل فقط مع GET الناجح 200 من نوع JSON. نحسب SHA-1 لمحتوى الاستجابة، ونضع Cache-Control: private, no-cache ثم نفحص If-None-Match عبر isNotModified.', 'private يمنع تخزين الاستجابة في كاش مشترك، وno-cache يطلب إعادة التحقق قبل إعادة استخدامها. إذا تغير المخزون يتغير الجسم وبالتالي ETag. الاستجابة 503 لا تتحول إلى 304. قياساتنا أظهرت تقليلًا في البايتات دون تحسن مثبت في زمن detail.'),
(backend('bootstrap/app.php'), 'تسجيل اسم middleware', 'سجلنا الاسم conditional.get لربطه بالمسارات المطلوبة.', 'التسجيل وحده لا يطبقه على كل API؛ ربط المسارات هو ما يحدد نطاق التنفيذ.'),
